-- Generated by scripts/build-bundle.ps1 from src/. Do not edit manually.
local __modules = {}
local __cache = {}

local function __require(name)
    if __cache[name] ~= nil then
        return __cache[name]
    end

    local loader = __modules[name]
    if not loader then
        error("AcrylicUI bundle missing module: " .. tostring(name), 2)
    end

    local value = loader()
    __cache[name] = value
    return value
end

__modules["Components.Button"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Button Component

    A clickable button with hover effects and icon support.
]]

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local Button = {}
Button.__index = Button
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ButtonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Button or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}



--[[
    Creates a new button component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config ButtonConfig - Button configuration
    @return ButtonObject - Button control object

    @example
    local button = Button.new(container, {
        Name = "Execute",
        Icon = "rbxassetid://10734898355",
        Callback = function()
            print("Button clicked!")
        end
    })
]]
function Button.new(parent, config)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Button)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or ButtonDefaults.Name or "Button"
    local icon = config.Icon or ComponentIcons.Button or "rbxassetid://10734898355"
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (Sizes.Component.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    self._connections = {}

    -- Main container
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Button_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    -- Button label
    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = hasDescription
                and UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7)
            or UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -(Sizes.Component.LabelCenterOffset or 10)
            ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Button.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Button.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Icon
    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Button.IconRightOffset or 30),
            0.5,
            -((Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20) / 2)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20, 0, Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Button)

    Create.Instance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {
        Parent = self._icon,
    })

    -- Click button
    self._button = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ClickArea",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._callback = callback

    -- Event handlers
    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            -- Click animation
            Tween.Create(
                self._frame,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.PressedTransparency or 0.2 },
                "Fast"
            )
            task.wait(CommonDefaults.ClickFlashDelay or 0.1)
            Tween.Create(
                self._frame,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4 },
                "Fast"
            )

            self._callback()
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            Tween.Create(
                self._frame,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.HoverTransparency or 0.3 },
                "Fast"
            )
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Tween.Create(
                self._frame,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4 },
                "Fast"
            )
        end)
    )

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    return self
end

function Button:SetText(text)
    self._label.Text = text
end

function Button:SetIcon(icon)
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Button)
end

function Button:SetCallback(callback)
    self._callback = callback
end

function Button:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return Button
end

__modules["Components.ColorPicker"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Layers = __require("Constants.Layers")
local Services = __require("Utils.Services")

local ColorPicker = {}
ColorPicker.__index = ColorPicker
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ColorPickerDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ColorPicker or {}
local ColorPickerLayers = Layers.ColorPicker or {}
local ColorPickerSizes = Sizes.ColorPicker or {}

-- Minimal color picker: preview + simple palette popup
local PRESETS = ColorPickerDefaults.Presets
    or {
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 128, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255),
    }

function ColorPicker.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ColorPicker)
    local name = (config and config.Name) or ColorPickerDefaults.Name or "Color Picker"
    self._callback = (config and config.Callback) or function() end
    self._color = (config and config.Default) or PRESETS[1]
    self._flag = config and config.Flag
    self._window = window
    self._connections = {}
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (ColorPickerSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "ColorPicker_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Name",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = hasDescription
                and UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7)
            or UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, 0),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    self._preview = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Preview",
        BackgroundColor3 = self._color,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.PreviewRightOffset or 45),
            0.5,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.PreviewVerticalOffset or 8)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PreviewWidth or 35,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PreviewHeight or 16
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.Corner(self._preview, Sizes.Corner.Small)
    Create.Stroke(self._preview)

    local previewBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._preview,
    })

    -- Palette popup
    self._palette = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Palette",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteWidth or 160,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteHeight or 70
        ),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = ColorPickerLayers.Palette or 2000,
        Parent = parent,
    })
    Create.Corner(self._palette, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._palette)
    Create.Padding(
        self._palette,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8
    )

    Create.Instance("UIGridLayout", {
        CellPadding = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteCellPadding or 8,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteCellPadding or 8
        ),
        CellSize = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24
        ),
        Parent = self._palette,
    })

    local function close()
        if self._isOpen then
            self._isOpen = false
            self._palette.Visible = false
            if self._outsideClickConn then
                self._outsideClickConn:Disconnect()
                self._outsideClickConn = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for _, col in ipairs(PRESETS) do
        local swatch = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
            BackgroundColor3 = col,
            Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24,
                0,
                ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24
            ),
            Parent = self._palette,
        })
        Create.Corner(swatch, Sizes.Corner.Small)
        Create.Stroke(swatch)
        table.insert(
            self._connections,
            swatch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if self._blocked then
                    return
                end

                self:SetColor(col)
                close()
            end)
        )
    end

    local function open()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        local p = self._preview.AbsolutePosition
        self._palette.Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            p.X - (ColorPickerSizes.PaletteWidth or 160) + (ColorPickerSizes.PreviewWidth or 35),
            0,
            p.Y + (ColorPickerSizes.PaletteYOffset or 22)
        )
        self._palette.Visible = true
        self._isOpen = true

        -- Connect outside-click handler
        if not self._outsideClickConn then
            self._outsideClickConn = Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
                function(input, gameProcessed)
                    if gameProcessed then
                        return
                    end
                    if
                        input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    if not self._isOpen then
                        return
                    end

                    local clickPos = input.Position

                    -- Click on palette → let swatch handle it
                    local palPos = self._palette.AbsolutePosition
                    local palSize = self._palette.AbsoluteSize
                    if
                        clickPos.X >= palPos.X
                        and clickPos.X <= palPos.X + palSize.X
                        and clickPos.Y >= palPos.Y
                        and clickPos.Y <= palPos.Y + palSize.Y
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    -- Click on preview → let toggle handle it
                    local prevPos = self._preview.AbsolutePosition
                    local prevSize = self._preview.AbsoluteSize
                    if
                        clickPos.X >= prevPos.X
                        and clickPos.X <= prevPos.X + prevSize.X
                        and clickPos.Y >= prevPos.Y
                        and clickPos.Y <= prevPos.Y + prevSize.Y
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    close()
                end
            )
            table.insert(self._connections, self._outsideClickConn)
        end
    end

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        previewBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if self._isOpen then
                close()
            else
                open()
            end
        end)
    )

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        close()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "ColorPicker", function()
            return self._color
        end, function(value)
            if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
                self:SetColor(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function ColorPicker:SetColor(color)
    self._color = color
    self._preview.BackgroundColor3 = color
    self._callback(color)
end

function ColorPicker:GetColor()
    return self._color
end

function ColorPicker:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    if self._palette then
        self._palette:Destroy()
    end
    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return ColorPicker
end

__modules["Components.ContentSection"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local Button = __require("Components.Button")
local Toggle = __require("Components.Toggle")
local Slider = __require("Components.Slider")
local Dropdown = __require("Components.Dropdown")
local TextBox = __require("Components.TextBox")

local ContentSection = {}
ContentSection.__index = ContentSection

local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ConfigUIDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ConfigUI or {}
local ConfigDefaults = Defaults.Config or {}
local MessageDefaults = Defaults.Messages or {}
local NotificationDefaults = Defaults.Notification or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local NotificationIcons = Icons.Notification or {}

function ContentSection.new(tab, config)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ContentSection)
    local sectionConfig = if type(config) == "table" then config else { Title = config }
    local title = tostring(sectionConfig.Title or sectionConfig.Name or "Section")
    local description = Create.GetDescription(sectionConfig)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local headerHeight = hasDescription and 54 or 42

    self._tab = tab
    self._window = tab._window
    self._title = title
    self._elements = {}

    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "ContentSection_" .. title,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Parent = tab._content,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)
    Create.ListLayout(self._frame, 0)

    self._header = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headerHeight),
        LayoutOrder = 0,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = title,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Section,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, hasDescription and 7 or 11),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, Sizes.Tab.SectionHeight or 25),
        Parent = self._header,
    })

    self._description = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Description",
        FontFace = Fonts.Light,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = description or "",
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Tiny,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14),
        Visible = hasDescription,
        Parent = self._header,
    })

    self._separator = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Separator",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Elements",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        LayoutOrder = 2,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Padding(self._container, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    Create.ListLayout(self._container, Sizes.Tab.ContentPadding or 8)

    return self
end

function ContentSection:_AddElement(element)
    table.insert(self._elements, element)
    return element
end

function ContentSection:Paragraph(config)
    local Paragraph = __require("Components.Paragraph")
    return self:_AddElement(Paragraph.new(self._container, config))
end

function ContentSection:Button(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Button.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Toggle(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Toggle.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Slider(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Slider.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Dropdown(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Dropdown.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Keybind(config)
    local Keybind = __require("Components.Keybind")
    return self:_AddElement(Keybind.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:ColorPicker(config)
    local ColorPicker = __require("Components.ColorPicker")
    return self:_AddElement(ColorPicker.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:TextBox(config)
    return self:_AddElement(TextBox.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:CreateConfigSection()
    local function getConfigOptions()
        local configs = self._window:GetConfigs()
        if #configs == 0 then
            return { ConfigDefaults.DefaultName or "default" }
        end
        return configs
    end

    local configNameBox = self:TextBox({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.ConfigName or "Config Name",
        Default = self._window._currentConfig,
        Placeholder = ConfigUIDefaults.ConfigPlaceholder or "Enter config name...",
        Callback = function(text)
            self._window._currentConfig = text
        end,
    })

    local configDropdown
    configDropdown = self:Dropdown({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.SelectConfig or "Select Config",
        Options = getConfigOptions(),
        Default = self._window._currentConfig,
        Callback = function(selected)
            if type(selected) == "string" then
                configNameBox:SetText(selected)
                self._window._currentConfig = selected
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.SaveConfig or "Save Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" and self._window:SaveConfig(configName) then
                configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.LoadConfig or "Load Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" then
                self._window:LoadConfig(configName)
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.DeleteConfig or "Delete Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" and self._window:DeleteConfig(configName) then
                configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.RefreshConfigs or "Refresh Configs",
        Callback = function()
            configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            self._window:Notify({
                Title = MessageDefaults.ConfigsRefreshedTitle or "Configs Refreshed",
                Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigsRefreshedDescription or "Config list updated",
                Duration = NotificationDefaults.SuccessDuration or 2,
                Icon = NotificationIcons.Config
                    or ComponentIcons.Config
                    or "rbxassetid://10723356507",
            })
        end,
    })

    self:Toggle({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.AutoSave or "Auto Save",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(enabled)
            self._window:SetAutoSave(enabled)
        end,
    })

    local autoLoadToggle = self:Toggle({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.AutoLoad or "Auto Load",
        Default = self._window:GetAutoLoad(),
        Callback = function(enabled)
            if not self._window:SetAutoLoad(enabled) then
                autoLoadToggle:SetValue(not enabled, true)
            end
        end,
    })

    return {
        RefreshConfigs = function()
            configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
        end,
    }
end

function ContentSection:Destroy()
    for _, element in ipairs(self._elements) do
        if element.Destroy then
            element:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._elements)

    if self._frame then
        self._frame:Destroy()
    end
end

return ContentSection
end

__modules["Components.Dropdown"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Dropdown Component

    A dropdown menu with single/multi-select support.
]]

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")
local Layers = __require("Constants.Layers")

local Dropdown = {}
Dropdown.__index = Dropdown
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local DropdownDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Dropdown or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local DropdownLayers = Layers.Dropdown or {}
local DropdownSizes = Sizes.Dropdown or {}
local SELECTED_ICON = ComponentIcons.DropdownSelected or "rbxassetid://16898669433"
local SEARCH_ICON = ComponentIcons.DropdownSearch or "rbxassetid://16898734242"

local function ResolveSearchConfig(searchConfig, name)
    if searchConfig == true then
        return true, "Search " .. name .. "..."
    end

    if type(searchConfig) == "string" then
        return true, searchConfig
    end

    if type(searchConfig) == "table" then
        local enabled = if searchConfig.Enabled == nil then true else searchConfig.Enabled == true
        local placeholder = searchConfig.Placeholder or "Search " .. name .. "..."
        return enabled, tostring(placeholder)
    end

    return false, ""
end



--[[
    Creates a new dropdown component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config DropdownConfig - Dropdown configuration
    @return DropdownObject - Dropdown control object
]]
function Dropdown.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Dropdown)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or DropdownDefaults.Name or "Dropdown"
    self._options = config.Options
        or DropdownDefaults.Options
        or { "Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3" }
    self._multiSelect = if config.MultiSelect == nil
        then (DropdownDefaults.MultiSelect or false)
        else config.MultiSelect
    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._expanded = false
    self._flag = config.Flag
    self._window = window
    self._connections = {}
    self._searchEnabled, self._searchPlaceholder = ResolveSearchConfig(config.Search, name)
    self._searchText = ""
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (DropdownSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Dropdown.Height

    -- Initialize selected value
    if self._multiSelect then
        self._selected = if type(config.Default) == "table" then config.Default else {}
    else
        self._selected = config.Default or self._options[1]
    end

    -- Main container
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Dropdown_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        ClipsDescendants = false,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Base or 1,
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    -- Label
    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, hasDescription and 6 or 10),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.LabelWidth or 200, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Label or 1,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.SectionHeaderHeight or 25),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.DescriptionRightPadding or 155),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Selected display
    self._display = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Display",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(DropdownSizes.DisplayRightOffset or 145), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135,
            0,
            DropdownSizes.DisplayHeight or 26
        ),
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._display, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._display)

    -- Selected label
    self._selectedLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "SelectedLabel",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = self:_GetDisplayText(),
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(DropdownSizes.SelectedLabelRightPadding or 30), 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.SelectedLabelPadding or 10, 0, 0),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._display,
    })

    -- Arrow indicator
    self._arrow = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Arrow",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.ArrowRightOffset or 20),
            0.5,
            -(DropdownSizes.ArrowVerticalOffset or 5)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.ArrowSize or 10, 0, DropdownSizes.ArrowSize or 10),
        Rotation = 0,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._display,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._arrow, nil, ComponentIcons.Arrow)

    -- Create options container
    self:_CreateOptionsContainer()

    -- Toggle button
    local toggleBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ToggleButton",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.ToggleButton or 3,
        Parent = self._display,
    })

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if self._expanded then
                self:Close()
            else
                self:Open()
            end
        end)
    )

    local contentContainer = self:_GetContentContainer()
    if contentContainer then
        table.insert(
            self._connections,
            contentContainer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
                if self._expanded then
                    self:Close()
                end
            end)
        )
    end

    local popupParent = self:_GetPopupParent()
    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        popupParent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            if self._expanded then
                self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._display:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function()
            if self._expanded then
                self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._display:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            if self._expanded then
                self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
            end
        end)
    )

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        component:Close()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "Dropdown", function()
            return self._selected
        end, function(value)
            if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "table" then
                self:SetValue(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function Dropdown:_GetDisplayText()
    if self._multiSelect then
        if #self._selected == 0 then
            return DropdownDefaults.NoneText or "None"
        end
        return table.concat(self._selected, DropdownDefaults.Separator or ", ")
    end
    return tostring(self._selected)
end

function Dropdown:_GetSearchAreaHeight()
    if not self._searchEnabled then
        return 0
    end

    return (DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34) + (DropdownSizes.SearchSeparatorHeight or 1)
end

function Dropdown:_GetFilteredOptions()
    local searchText = string.lower(tostring(self._searchText or ""))
    if not self._searchEnabled or searchText == "" then
        return self._options
    end

    local filtered = {}
    for _, option in ipairs(self._options) do
        if string.find(string.lower(tostring(option)), searchText, 1, true) then
            table.insert(filtered, option)
        end
    end

    return filtered
end

function Dropdown:_IsSelected(option)
    if self._multiSelect then
        return table.find(self._selected, option) ~= nil
    end

    return self._selected == option
end

function Dropdown:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount)
    local maxVisible = DropdownSizes.MaxVisibleOptions or Sizes.Dropdown.MaxVisibleOptions
    local optionHeight = DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight
    local searchAreaHeight = self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()
    local contentHeight = if visibleCount == 0
        then (DropdownSizes.EmptyHeight or 42)
        else math.min(visibleCount, maxVisible) * optionHeight

    return searchAreaHeight + contentHeight
end

function Dropdown:_GetPopupParent()
    if self._window and self._window.GetPopupLayer then
        local ok, popupLayer = pcall(function()
            return self._window:GetPopupLayer()
        end)

        if ok and popupLayer then
            return popupLayer
        end
    end

    return self._frame
end

function Dropdown:_GetContentContainer()
    if self._window and self._window.GetContentContainer then
        local ok, contentContainer = pcall(function()
            return self._window:GetContentContainer()
        end)

        if ok and contentContainer then
            return contentContainer
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Dropdown:_UpdateOptionsLayout(visibleCount, popupHeight)
    local width = DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135
    local searchAreaHeight = self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()
    local resolvedPopupHeight = popupHeight or self:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount)
    local scrollHeight = math.max(0, resolvedPopupHeight - searchAreaHeight)
    local optionHeight = DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight

    self._optionsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, resolvedPopupHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, searchAreaHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, scrollHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, visibleCount * optionHeight)

    if self._emptyState then
        self._emptyState.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, searchAreaHeight)
        self._emptyState.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, scrollHeight)
    end
end

function Dropdown:_PositionOptionsContainer(visibleCount)
    local popupParent = self:_GetPopupParent()
    if self._optionsContainer.Parent ~= popupParent then
        self._optionsContainer.Parent = popupParent
    end

    local margin = DropdownSizes.PopupMargin or 4
    local width = DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or self._display.AbsoluteSize.X
    local desiredHeight = self:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount)
    local parentPosition = popupParent.AbsolutePosition
    local parentSize = popupParent.AbsoluteSize
    local displayPosition = self._display.AbsolutePosition
    local displaySize = self._display.AbsoluteSize

    local relativeX = displayPosition.X - parentPosition.X
    local belowY = displayPosition.Y
        - parentPosition.Y
        + displaySize.Y
        - (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
    local aboveBottomY = displayPosition.Y - parentPosition.Y + (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
    local availableBelow = parentSize.Y - belowY - margin
    local availableAbove = aboveBottomY - margin
    local openUp = desiredHeight > availableBelow and availableAbove > availableBelow
    local availableHeight = math.max(0, if openUp then availableAbove else availableBelow)
    local resolvedHeight = math.min(desiredHeight, availableHeight)

    if resolvedHeight <= 0 then
        resolvedHeight = math.min(desiredHeight, parentSize.Y)
    end

    local maxX = math.max(margin, parentSize.X - width - margin)
    local relativeY = if openUp then aboveBottomY - resolvedHeight else belowY
    local maxY = math.max(margin, parentSize.Y - resolvedHeight - margin)

    self._optionsContainer.Position =
        UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(relativeX, margin, maxX), 0, math.clamp(relativeY, margin, maxY))
    self:_UpdateOptionsLayout(visibleCount, resolvedHeight)
end

function Dropdown:_CreateOptionsContainer()
    local totalHeight = self:_GetPopupHeight(#self._options)

    self._optionsContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "OptionsContainer",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.DisplayRightOffset or 145),
            0,
            self._frame.AbsoluteSize.Y - (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135, 0, totalHeight),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Parent = self:_GetPopupParent(),
    })

    Create.Corner(self._optionsContainer, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._optionsContainer)

    if self._searchEnabled then
        self._searchContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
            Name = "Search",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = self._optionsContainer,
        })

        local searchIcon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "SearchIcon",
            ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -((DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16) / 2)
            ),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16,
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16
            ),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 2,
            Parent = self._searchContainer,
        })
        Create.ApplyIcon(searchIcon, nil, SEARCH_ICON)

        self._searchInput = Create.Instance("TextBox", {
            Name = "SearchInput",
            FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
            TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
            PlaceholderText = self._searchPlaceholder,
            PlaceholderColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
            Text = "",
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.SearchTextLeft or 34, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -((DropdownSizes.SearchTextLeft or 34) + 10), 1, 0),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 2,
            Parent = self._searchContainer,
        })

        table.insert(
            self._connections,
            self._searchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                self._searchText = self._searchInput.Text
                self:_PopulateOptions()
            end)
        )

        Create.Instance("Frame", {
            Name = "SearchSeparator",
            BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchSeparatorHeight or 1),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = self._optionsContainer,
        })
    end

    self._optionsScroll = Create.Instance("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "Scroll",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #self._options * (DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or 30)),
        ScrollBarThickness = DropdownSizes.ScrollbarThickness or 3,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = Colors.Scrollbar,
        ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.7,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
        Parent = self._optionsContainer,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._optionsScroll, 0)

    self._emptyState = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "EmptyState",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = "Not found any",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
        Parent = self._optionsContainer,
    })

    self:_PopulateOptions()
end

function Dropdown:_PopulateOptions()
    for _, child in ipairs(self._optionsScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local filteredOptions = self:_GetFilteredOptions()
    local hasOptions = #filteredOptions > 0
    if self._expanded then
        self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#filteredOptions)
    else
        self:_UpdateOptionsLayout(#filteredOptions)
    end
    self._optionsScroll.Visible = hasOptions
    if self._emptyState then
        self._emptyState.Visible = not hasOptions
    end

    for _, option in ipairs(filteredOptions) do
        local selected = self:_IsSelected(option)
        local optionBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
            Name = "Option_" .. option,
            Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.9 or (CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight),
            ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
            Parent = self._optionsScroll,
        })

        local selectedIcon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "SelectedIcon",
            ImageColor3 = Colors.Text,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconLeft or 12,
                0.5,
                -((DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14) / 2)
            ),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14,
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14
            ),
            Visible = selected,
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = optionBtn,
        })
        Create.ApplyIcon(selectedIcon, nil, SELECTED_ICON)

        local optionText = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
            Name = "OptionText",
            FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
            TextColor3 = selected and Colors.Text or Colors.TextDark,
            Text = option,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.OptionTextLeft or 36, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                -(
                        (DropdownSizes.OptionTextLeft or 36)
                        + (DropdownSizes.OptionTextRightPadding or 10)
                    ),
                1,
                0
            ),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = optionBtn,
        })

        local function setHoverVisual(hovering)
            local backgroundTransparency = if hovering
                then (if selected then 0.68 else 0.78)
                else (if selected then 0.9 else (CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1))
            local textColor = if hovering or selected then Colors.Text else Colors.TextDark

            Tween.Create(optionBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency }, "Fast")
            Tween.Create(optionText, { TextColor3 = textColor }, "Fast")
            if selectedIcon.Visible then
                Tween.Create(selectedIcon, { ImageColor3 = textColor }, "Fast")
            end
        end

        optionBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            setHoverVisual(true)
        end)

        optionBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            setHoverVisual(false)
        end)

        optionBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if self._multiSelect then
                local index = table.find(self._selected, option)
                if index then
                    table.remove(self._selected, index)
                else
                    table.insert(self._selected, option)
                end
                self:_UpdateDisplay()
                self:_PopulateOptions()
                self._callback(self._selected)
            else
                self._selected = option
                self:_UpdateDisplay()
                self:_PopulateOptions()
                self._callback(self._selected)
                self:Close()
            end
        end)
    end
end

function Dropdown:_UpdateDisplay()
    self._selectedLabel.Text = self:_GetDisplayText()
end

function Dropdown:Open()
    if self._blocked then
        return
    end

    self._expanded = true
    self:_PopulateOptions()
    self._optionsContainer.Visible = true
    Tween.Create(self._arrow, { Rotation = 180 }, "Normal")
    self._frame.ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Open or 10
end

function Dropdown:Close()
    self._expanded = false
    self._optionsContainer.Visible = false
    Tween.Create(self._arrow, { Rotation = 0 }, "Normal")
    self._frame.ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Base or 1
end

function Dropdown:SetValue(value)
    if self._multiSelect then
        if type(value) == "table" then
            self._selected = value
        end
    else
        self._selected = value
    end
    self:_UpdateDisplay()
    if self._optionsScroll then
        self:_PopulateOptions()
    end
    self._callback(self._selected)
end

function Dropdown:GetValue()
    return self._selected
end

function Dropdown:Refresh(options)
    self._options = options
    self:_PopulateOptions()
end

function Dropdown:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    if self._optionsContainer then
        self._optionsContainer:Destroy()
    end

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return Dropdown
end

__modules["Components.Keybind"] = function()
local Services = __require("Utils.Services")

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local Keybind = {}
Keybind.__index = Keybind
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local KeybindDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Keybind or {}
local KeybindSizes = Sizes.Keybind or {}

function Keybind.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Keybind)

    local name = (config and config.Name) or KeybindDefaults.Name or "Keybind"
    local default = (config and config.Default) or KeybindDefaults.Key or Enum.KeyCode.F
    local callback = (config and config.Callback) or function() end
    local flag = config and config.Flag
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (KeybindSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Keybind_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Name",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = hasDescription
                and UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7)
            or UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -(Sizes.Component.LabelCenterOffset or 10)
            ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, KeybindSizes.LabelWidth or 200, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(0, KeybindSizes.LabelWidth or 200, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14)
    )

    self._box = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "KeyBox",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(KeybindSizes.BoxRightOffset or 10), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            KeybindSizes.BoxWidth or KeybindDefaults.BoxWidth or 30,
            0,
            KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._box, Sizes.Corner.Small)
    Create.Stroke(self._box)

    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Key",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = default.Name,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._box,
    })

    self._listenBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Listen",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._box,
    })

    self._currentKey = default
    self._listening = false
    self._flag = flag
    self._window = window
    self._connections = {}

    self._id = name
        .. "_"
        .. tostring(math.floor(os.clock() * (KeybindDefaults.IdClockScale or 1000)))
    window:RegisterKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        callback()
    end)

    local function refresh()
        if self._listening then
            self._label.Text = KeybindDefaults.ListeningText or "..."
            self._box.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                KeybindSizes.ListeningWidth or KeybindDefaults.ListeningWidth or 43,
                0,
                KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26
            )
        else
            local keyName = self._currentKey.Name
            local w = math.max(
                #keyName * (KeybindDefaults.TextWidthScale or 9)
                    + (KeybindDefaults.TextWidthPadding or 10),
                KeybindDefaults.MinWidth or 24
            )
            self._box.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26)
            self._label.Text = keyName
        end
    end

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._listenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            self._listening = true
            refresh()
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, _gameProcessed)
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if not self._listening then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                self._currentKey = input.KeyCode
                self._listening = false
                window:UpdateKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey)
                refresh()
            end
        end)
    )

    self._refresh = refresh

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        component._listening = false
        component._refresh()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "Keybind", function()
            return self._currentKey
        end, function(value)
            if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
                self:SetKey(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    refresh()
    return self
end

function Keybind:SetKey(key)
    self._currentKey = key
    self._window:UpdateKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey)
    self._refresh()
end

function Keybind:GetKey()
    return self._currentKey
end

function Keybind:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._window then
        self._window:UnregisterKeybind(self._id)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return Keybind
end

__modules["Components.Paragraph"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local Paragraph = {}
Paragraph.__index = Paragraph
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ParagraphDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Paragraph or {}

function Paragraph.new(parent, config)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Paragraph)
    local title = (config and config.Title) or ParagraphDefaults.Title or "Paragraph"
    local content = (config and config.Content)
        or ParagraphDefaults.Content
        or "Description text here."

    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Paragraph",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
