    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)
    Create.Padding(self._frame, 10, 10, 10, 10)

    self._title = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = title,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Sizes.Paragraph.TitleHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._content = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Content",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = content,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextWrapped = true,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, Sizes.Paragraph.ContentTop or 22),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    return self
end

function Paragraph:SetTitle(text)
    self._title.Text = text
end

function Paragraph:SetContent(text)
    self._content.Text = text
end

return Paragraph
end

__modules["Components.Section"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local Section = {}
Section.__index = Section
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = Defaults.Components and Defaults.Components.Common or {}

function Section.new(window, name)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Section)
    self._window = window
    self._name = name
    self._tabs = {}
    self._connections = {}

    -- Sidebar section frame
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Section_" .. name,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Section.FrameRightPadding or 10), 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Parent = window:GetSectionsContainer(),
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._frame, Sizes.Section.LayoutPadding or 2)

    -- Header container
    local header = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Sizes.Section.HeaderHeight or 25),
        LayoutOrder = 0,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Click area
    local headerBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "HeaderButton",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = header,
    })

    -- Label
    local label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Section.LabelLeft or 5, 0, 0),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Section.LabelRightPadding or 25), 1, 0),
        Parent = header,
    })

    -- Arrow
    local arrow = Create.Instance("ImageButton", {
        Name = "Arrow",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Section.ArrowRightOffset or 20),
            0.5,
            -(Sizes.Section.ArrowVerticalOffset or 7)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Section.ArrowSize or 15, 0, Sizes.Section.ArrowSize or 15),
        Rotation = 0,
        Parent = header,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(arrow, nil, ComponentIcons.Arrow)

    -- Tabs container
    self._tabsContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Tabs",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._tabsContainer, Sizes.Section.LayoutPadding or 2)
    Create.Padding(self._tabsContainer, 2, 2, Sizes.Section.TabsIndent or 15, 0)

    local expanded = true
    local function toggle()
        expanded = not expanded
        Tween.Create(arrow, { Rotation = expanded and 0 or 180 }, "Normal")
        self._tabsContainer.Visible = expanded
    end

    table.insert(self._connections, headerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle))
    table.insert(self._connections, arrow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle))

    self._label = label
    self._arrow = arrow

    return self
end

function Section:CreateTab(name, icon)
    local Tab = __require("Components.Tab")
    local tab = Tab.new(self._window, self, name, icon)
    table.insert(self._tabs, tab)
    return tab
end

function Section:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    for _, tab in ipairs(self._tabs) do
        if tab.Destroy then
            tab:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._tabs)

    if self._frame then
        self._frame:Destroy()
    end
end

return Section
end

__modules["Components.Slider"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Slider Component

    A draggable slider for numeric value selection.
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local Slider = {}
Slider.__index = Slider
local SliderDefaults = Defaults.Slider
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local SliderComponentDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Slider or {}



local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function resolveNumber(value, fallback)
    if isFiniteNumber(value) then
        return value
    end

    return fallback
end

local function resolveRange(minValue, maxValue)
    local min = resolveNumber(minValue, SliderDefaults.Min)
    local max = resolveNumber(maxValue, SliderDefaults.Max)

    if max < min then
        min, max = max, min
    end

    return min, max
end

local function resolveIncrement(increment)
    local resolved = resolveNumber(increment, SliderDefaults.Increment)
    if resolved <= 0 then
        return SliderDefaults.Increment
    end

    return resolved
end

local function normalizeValue(
    value,
    fallback,
    min,
    max,
    increment
)
    local resolved = resolveNumber(value, fallback)
    local snapped = math.floor(resolved / increment + 0.5) * increment

    return math.clamp(snapped, min, max)
end

--[[
    Creates a new slider component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config SliderConfig - Slider configuration
    @return SliderObject - Slider control object
]]
function Slider.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Slider)

    local name = config.Name or SliderComponentDefaults.Name or "Slider"
    self._min, self._max = resolveRange(config.Min, config.Max)
    self._increment = resolveIncrement(config.Increment)
    self._value =
        normalizeValue(config.Default, SliderDefaults.Value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._dragging = false
    self._flag = config.Flag
    self._window = window
    self._connections = {}
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.HeightWithDescription or 56)
        or Sizes.Slider.Height

    -- Main container
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Slider_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    -- Label
    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
            0,
            hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTopWithDescription or 4)
                or (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTop or 5)
        ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Slider.LabelWidth or 200, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Slider.DescriptionTop or 22),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Slider.DescriptionRightPadding or 80),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Value display
    self._valueLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Value",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = tostring(self._value),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Slider.ValueRightOffset or 60),
            0,
            hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTopWithDescription or 4)
                or (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTop or 5)
        ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Slider.ValueWidth or 50, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Track background
    self._track = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Track",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            Sizes.Slider.TrackHorizontalPadding or 10,
            0,
            hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.TrackTopWithDescription or 39)
                or (Sizes.Slider.TrackTop or 29)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -((Sizes.Slider.TrackHorizontalPadding or 10) * 2),
            0,
            Sizes.Slider.TrackHeight
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._track, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Fill bar
    local range = math.max(self._max - self._min, 1)
    local initialFill = (self._value - self._min) / range
    self._fill = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Fill",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(initialFill, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._track,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._fill, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Input handling
    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            then
                self._dragging = true
                self:_UpdateFromInput(input)
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._track.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            then
                self._dragging = false
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if
                self._dragging
                and not self._blocked
                and (
                    input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                )
            then
                self:_UpdateFromInput(input)
            end
        end)
    )

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        component._dragging = false
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "Slider", function()
            return self._value
        end, function(value)
            if type(value) == "number" then
                self:SetValue(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function Slider:_UpdateFromInput(input)
    local pos = input.Position
    local trackPos = self._track.AbsolutePosition
    local trackSize = self._track.AbsoluteSize

    local relativeX = math.clamp((pos.X - trackPos.X) / trackSize.X, 0, 1)
    local rawValue = self._min + (self._max - self._min) * relativeX

    -- Apply increment
    self._value = normalizeValue(rawValue, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)

    self:_UpdateVisual()
    self._callback(self._value)
end

function Slider:_UpdateVisual()
    local range = math.max(self._max - self._min, 1)
    local fillRatio = math.clamp((self._value - self._min) / range, 0, 1)
    Tween.Create(self._fill, { Size = UDim2.new(fillRatio, 0, 1, 0) }, "Instant")
    self._valueLabel.Text = tostring(self._value)
end

function Slider:SetValue(value)
    self._value = normalizeValue(value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
    self._callback(self._value)
end

function Slider:GetValue()
    return self._value
end

function Slider:SetMin(min)
    self._min = resolveNumber(min, self._min)
    if self._max < self._min then
        self._max = self._min
    end
    self._value = normalizeValue(self._value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
end

function Slider:SetMax(max)
    self._max = resolveNumber(max, self._max)
    if self._max < self._min then
        self._min = self._max
    end
    self._value = normalizeValue(self._value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
end

function Slider:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return Slider
end

__modules["Components.Tab"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local Button = __require("Components.Button")
local Toggle = __require("Components.Toggle")
local Slider = __require("Components.Slider")
local Dropdown = __require("Components.Dropdown")
local TextBox = __require("Components.TextBox")

local Tab = {}
Tab.__index = Tab
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ConfigUIDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ConfigUI or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local function closePopupsInElements(elements)
    for _, element in ipairs(elements) do
        if element then
            if type(element.Close) == "function" then
                element:Close()
            end
            if type(element._elements) == "table" then
                closePopupsInElements(element._elements)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Tab.new(window, section, name, icon)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Tab)
    self._window = window
    self._section = section
    self._name = name
    self._elements = {}
    self._connections = {}

    -- Button in sidebar
    self._button = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, Sizes.Tab.Height),
        Parent = section._tabsContainer,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._button, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    self._stroke = Create.Stroke(self._button, Colors.Border, 1)
    self._stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round

    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.IconLeft or 11, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.IconSize or 15, 0, Sizes.Tab.IconSize or 15),
        Parent = self._button,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Tab)

    self._text = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "TabText",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.TextLeft or 33, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Tab.TextRightPadding or 42), 1, 0),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Parent = self._button,
    })

    Create.Instance(
        "UIPadding",
        { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, Sizes.Tab.TextPaddingRight or 9), Parent = self._text }
    )

    local click = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Click",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._button,
    })

    -- Content frame
    self._content = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = name .. "_Content",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Visible = false,
        Parent = window:GetContentContainer(),
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._content, Sizes.Tab.ContentPadding or 8)

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            window:SelectTab(self)
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if window._currentTab ~= self then
                Tween.Create(
                    self._button,
                    { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.HoverFaintTransparency or 0.7 },
                    "Fast"
                )
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if window._currentTab ~= self then
                Tween.Create(
                    self._button,
                    { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1 },
                    "Fast"
                )
            end
        end)
    )

    if not window._currentTab then
        window:SelectTab(self)
    end

    return self
end

function Tab:_AddElement(element)
    table.insert(self._elements, element)
    return element
end

function Tab:Select()
    self._content.Visible = true
    Tween.Create(self._button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._text, { TextColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    self._stroke.Transparency = 0
end

function Tab:Deselect()
    self._content.Visible = false
    Tween.Create(self._button, { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1 }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._text, { TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    self._stroke.Transparency = 1
    closePopupsInElements(self._elements)
end

-- Content helpers
function Tab:CreateSection(config)
    local ContentSection = __require("Components.ContentSection")
    return self:_AddElement(ContentSection.new(self, config))
end

function Tab:Paragraph(config)
    local Paragraph = __require("Components.Paragraph")
    return self:_AddElement(Paragraph.new(self._content, config))
end

function Tab:Button(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Button.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Toggle(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Toggle.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Slider(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Slider.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Dropdown(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Dropdown.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Keybind(config)
    local Keybind = __require("Components.Keybind")
    return self:_AddElement(Keybind.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:ColorPicker(config)
    local ColorPicker = __require("Components.ColorPicker")
    return self:_AddElement(ColorPicker.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:TextBox(config)
    return self:_AddElement(TextBox.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:CreateConfigSection()
    local section = self:CreateSection(ConfigUIDefaults.SectionTitle or "Configuration")
    return section:CreateConfigSection()
end

function Tab:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    for _, element in ipairs(self._elements) do
        if element.Destroy then
            element:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._elements)

    if self._content then
        self._content:Destroy()
    end

    if self._button then
        self._button:Destroy()
    end
end

return Tab
end

__modules["Components.TextBox"] = function()
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local TextBox = {}
TextBox.__index = TextBox
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local TextBoxDefaults = ComponentDefaults.TextBox or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local TextBoxSizes = Sizes.TextBox or {}


function TextBox.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, TextBox)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or TextBoxDefaults.Name or "TextBox"
    local placeholder = config.Placeholder or TextBoxDefaults.Placeholder or "Enter text..."
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (TextBoxSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.TextBox.Height

    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._text = tostring(config.Default or TextBoxDefaults.DefaultText or "")
    self._connections = {}
    self._window = window
    self._flag = config.Flag
    self._numbersOnly = if config.NumbersOnly == nil
        then (TextBoxDefaults.NumbersOnly or false)
        else config.NumbersOnly

    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "TextBox_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Name",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = hasDescription
                and UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7)
            or UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -(Sizes.Component.LabelCenterOffset or 10)
            ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(TextBoxSizes.LabelRightPadding or 190),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(TextBoxSizes.LabelRightPadding or 190),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.IconRightOffset or 165), 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, TextBoxSizes.IconSize or 18, 0, TextBoxSizes.IconSize or 18),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, nil, ComponentIcons.TextBox)

    self._container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "TextBoxContainer",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.InputRightOffset or 10), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.TextBox.InputWidth, 0, TextBoxSizes.InputHeight or 26),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._container, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    self._stroke = Create.Stroke(self._container)

    self._input = Create.Instance("TextBox", {
        Name = "Input",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        PlaceholderText = placeholder,
        PlaceholderColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = self._text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.InputTextRightPadding or 16), 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, TextBoxSizes.InputTextPadding or 8, 0, 0),
        ClearTextOnFocus = if config.ClearOnFocus == nil
            then (TextBoxDefaults.ClearOnFocus or false)
            else config.ClearOnFocus,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._input.Focused:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                self._input:ReleaseFocus()
                return
            end

            Tween.Create(self._container, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, "Fast")
            Tween.Create(self._stroke, { Color = Colors.Accent }, "Fast")
            Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
            Tween.Create(
                self._container,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04 },
                "Fast"
            )
            Tween.Create(self._stroke, { Color = Colors.Border }, "Fast")
            Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")

            if self._numbersOnly then
                local numberValue = tonumber(self._input.Text)
                if numberValue then
                    self._text = tostring(numberValue)
                end
                self._input.Text = self._text
            else
                self._text = self._input.Text
            end

            self._callback(self._text, enterPressed)
        end)
    )

    if self._numbersOnly then
        table.insert(
            self._connections,
            self._input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                local filtered = self._input.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
                if self._input.Text ~= filtered then
                    self._input.Text = filtered
                end
            end)
        )
    end

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        component._input:ReleaseFocus()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "TextBox", function()
            return self._text
        end, function(value)
            if type(value) == "string" then
                self:SetText(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function TextBox:SetText(text)
    self._text = tostring(text or "")
    self._input.Text = self._text
end

function TextBox:GetText()
    return self._text
end

function TextBox:SetPlaceholder(placeholder)
    self._input.PlaceholderText = placeholder
end

function TextBox:Focus()
    if self._blocked then
        return
    end

    self._input:CaptureFocus()
end

function TextBox:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return TextBox
end

__modules["Components.Toggle"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Toggle Component

    A toggle switch with smooth animations.
]]

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local Toggle = {}
Toggle.__index = Toggle
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ToggleDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Toggle or {}



--[[
    Creates a new toggle component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config ToggleConfig - Toggle configuration
    @return ToggleObject - Toggle control object
]]
function Toggle.new(parent, config, window)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Toggle)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or ToggleDefaults.Name or "Toggle"
    local default = if config.Default == nil
        then (ToggleDefaults.Enabled or false)
        else config.Default
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (Sizes.Component.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height
    local knobPadding = Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4
    local knobEnabledX = Sizes.Toggle.Width - Sizes.Toggle.Circle - knobPadding

    self._enabled = default
    self._callback = callback
    self._flag = config.Flag
    self._window = window
    self._connections = {}

    -- Main container
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Toggle_" .. name,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Parent = parent,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._frame, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._frame)

    -- Label
    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = hasDescription
                and UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7)
            or UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -(Sizes.Component.LabelCenterOffset or 10)
            ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.LabelRightPadding or 60),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.LabelRightPadding or 60),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Switch background
    self._switchBg = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "SwitchBackground",
        BackgroundColor3 = self._enabled and Colors.Toggle.Enabled or Colors.Toggle.Disabled,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.RightOffset or 48),
            0.5,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.VerticalOffset or 10)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Width, 0, Sizes.Toggle.Height),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._switchBg, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Switch circle
    self._circle = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Circle",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Circle,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = if self._enabled
            then UDim2.new(0, knobEnabledX, 0.5, 0)
            else UDim2.new(0, knobPadding, 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Circle, 0, Sizes.Toggle.Circle),
        Parent = self._switchBg,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._circle, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Click area
    local button = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ClickArea",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            self:SetValue(not self._enabled)
        end)
    )

    Create.Blockable(self, self._frame)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text)
        if component._enabled then
            component:SetValue(false)
        end

        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        self._window:RegisterConfigElement(self._flag, "Toggle", function()
            return self._enabled
        end, function(value)
            if type(value) == "boolean" then
                self:SetValue(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function Toggle:_UpdateVisual()
    if self._enabled then
        Tween.Create(self._switchBg, { BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Enabled }, "Normal")
        Tween.Create(self._circle, {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Toggle.Width - Sizes.Toggle.Circle - (Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4),
                0.5,
                0
            ),
        }, "Normal")
    else
        Tween.Create(self._switchBg, { BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Disabled }, "Normal")
        Tween.Create(
            self._circle,
            { Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4, 0.5, 0) },
            "Normal"
        )
    end
end

function Toggle:SetValue(value, silent)
    self._enabled = value
    self:_UpdateVisual()
    if not silent then
        self._callback(self._enabled)
    end
end

function Toggle:GetValue()
    return self._enabled
end

function Toggle:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._flag and self._window and self._window.UnregisterConfigElement then
        self._window:UnregisterConfigElement(self._flag)
    end

    self._frame:Destroy()
end

return Toggle
end

__modules["Constants.Animation"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Animation Constants

    Timing and easing configurations for smooth animations.
]]

local Animation = {
    -- Duration presets (in seconds)
    Duration = {
        Instant = 0.05,
        Fast = 0.1,
        Normal = 0.15,
        Slow = 0.2,
        VerySlow = 0.3,
    },

    -- Default easing style
    DefaultEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,

    -- Default easing direction
    DefaultDirection = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,

    -- Spring configurations for bouncy effects
    Spring = {
        Damping = 1,
        Frequency = 3,
    },
}

--[[
    Creates a TweenInfo with preset values

    @param duration string | number - Duration preset name or custom value
    @param easing Enum.EasingStyle? - Optional easing style
    @param direction Enum.EasingDirection? - Optional easing direction
    @return TweenInfo
]]
function Animation.CreateTweenInfo(
    duration,
    easing,
    direction
)
    local actualDuration = if type(duration) == "string"
        then Animation.Duration[duration] or Animation.Duration.Normal
        else duration

    return TweenInfo.new(
        actualDuration,
        easing or Animation.DefaultEasing,
        direction or Animation.DefaultDirection
    )
end

return Animation
end

__modules["Constants.Colors"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Color Constants

    Default theme colors for the UI library.
    Supports dark mode with acrylic/glass aesthetics.
    Provides a runtime-applicable theme system via SetTheme/ResetTheme.
]]

local function deepCopy(t)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
            copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
        else
            copy[k] = v
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function deepMerge(base, overrides)
    local result = deepCopy(base)
    for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
        if type(value) == "table" and type(result[key]) == "table" then
            result[key] = deepMerge(result[key], value)
        else
            result[key] = value
        end
    end
    return result
end

local Colors = {
    -- Primary colors
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
    Border = Color3.fromRGB(39, 39, 39),

    -- Text colors
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextDark = Color3.fromRGB(93, 93, 93),
    TextFade = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 9),

    -- Accent color (customizable)
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

    -- Toggle specific colors
    Toggle = {
        Enabled = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Disabled = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32),
        Circle = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
    },

    -- Notification specific colors
    Notification = {
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(11, 11, 11),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26),
        Timer = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    },

    -- Window control colors
    CloseHover = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100),
    ResizeHandle = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110),
    Scrollbar = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60),
}

-- Frozen snapshot of factory defaults for ResetTheme
Colors._defaults = deepCopy(Colors)

--[[
    Applies a partial theme override to the active Colors table.
    Nested tables (Toggle, Notification) are deep-merged.

    @param overrides table - Partial color overrides
]]
function Colors:SetTheme(overrides)
    if not overrides then
        return
    end

    for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
        if key == "_defaults" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" and type(self[key]) == "table" then
            self[key] = deepMerge(self[key], value)
        else
            self[key] = value
        end
    end
end

--[[
    Restores all colors to the factory defaults captured at load time.
]]
function Colors:ResetTheme()
    for key, value in pairs(self._defaults) do
        if key == "_defaults" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" then
            self[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            self[key] = value
        end
    end
end

--[[
    Returns a standalone copy of the current theme without the methods.

    @return table - Snapshot of current color values
]]
function Colors:Snapshot()
    local snapshot = {}
    for key, value in pairs(self) do
        if key == "_defaults" or type(value) == "function" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" then
            snapshot[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            snapshot[key] = value
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

return Colors
end

__modules["Constants.Sizes"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Size Constants

    Dimension constants for UI components.
    All values are in pixels unless otherwise specified.
]]

local Sizes = {
    -- Window dimensions
    Window = {
        Width = 690,
        Height = 446,
    },

    WindowChrome = {
        MinMobileWidth = 320,
        MinMobileHeight = 240,
        MobileViewportMargin = 24,
        DesktopViewportMargin = 40,
        HeaderHeight = 45,
        ContentTop = 46,
        SidebarWidth = 165,
        ContentLeft = 166,
        ContentScrollbarThickness = 3,
        TitleX = 10,
        TitleY = 10,
        TitleWidth = 150,
        TitleHeight = 25,
        ControlTop = 15,
        ControlSize = 15,
        MinimizeRightOffset = 35,
        MinimizeClickWidth = 21,
        CloseRightOffset = 10,
        TopBarControlsWidth = 80,
        ResizeOffset = 5,
        ResizeWidth = 62,
        ResizeHeight = 60,
        BottomDragWidth = 140,
        BottomDragHeight = 18,
        BottomDragBarWidth = 90,
        BottomDragBarHeight = 4,
        BottomDragBarHoldingHeight = 5.5,
        BottomDragBarTop = 4.5,
        MobileToggleSize = 50,
        MobileToggleCorner = 25,
        MobileToggleX = 15,
        MobileToggleYOffset = -25,
        MobileTapThreshold = 10,
    },

    -- Minimum window size (for resizing)

__modules["Core.AcrylicBlur"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Acrylic Blur Effect

    Creates a frosted glass blur effect behind UI elements.
    Handles camera nil-check and reconnects on camera swap (respawn).
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local AcrylicBlur = {}
AcrylicBlur.__index = AcrylicBlur
local BlurDefaults = Defaults.AcrylicBlur or {}

local nextBlurId = 0

--[[
    Creates a new acrylic blur effect

    @param targetFrame GuiObject - The frame to apply blur behind
    @return AcrylicBlur - Blur instance
]]
function AcrylicBlur.new(targetFrame)
    local self = setmetatable({}, AcrylicBlur)
    nextBlurId += 1

    self._target = targetFrame
    self._id = nextBlurId
    self._folderName = (BlurDefaults.FolderPrefix or "AcrylicBlur_") .. tostring(self._id)
    self._dofName = (BlurDefaults.DepthOfFieldPrefix or "AcrylicBlurDepthOfField_")
        .. tostring(self._id)
    self._blurName = (BlurDefaults.BlurPrefix or "AcrylicBlurEffect_") .. tostring(self._id)
    self._folder = nil
    self._root = nil
    self._frame = nil
    self._blur = nil
    self._dof = nil
    self._enabled = true
    self._connections = {}
    self._cameraConnections = {}
    self._renderUpdate = nil
    self._onChange = nil
    self._destroyed = false

    self:_Initialize()

    return self
end

function AcrylicBlur:_CreateEffects()
    self._dof = Create.Instance("DepthOfFieldEffect", {
        Name = self._dofName,
        FarIntensity = BlurDefaults.FarIntensity or 0,
        FocusDistance = BlurDefaults.FocusDistance or 0.01,
        InFocusRadius = BlurDefaults.InFocusRadius or 0.01,
        NearIntensity = BlurDefaults.NearIntensity or 1,
        Parent = Services.Lighting,
    })

    self._blur = Create.Instance("BlurEffect", {
        Name = self._blurName,
        Size = BlurDefaults.BlurSize or 6,
        Enabled = true,
        Parent = Services.Lighting,
    })
end

function AcrylicBlur:_CreateMesh()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return
    end

    self._folder = Create.Instance("Folder", {
        Name = self._folderName,
        Parent = camera,
    })

    self._root = Create.Instance("Part", {
        Name = "Root",
        Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
        Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0),
        Anchored = true,
        CanCollide = false,
        CanQuery = false,
        CastShadow = false,
        Transparency = BlurDefaults.RootTransparency or 0.9,
        Parent = self._folder,
    })

    pcall(function()
        self._root.Locked = true
    end)

    Create.Instance("SpecialMesh", {
        MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick,
        Parent = self._root,
    })
end

function AcrylicBlur:_CreateTrackingFrame()
    self._frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Parent = self._target,
    })
end

function AcrylicBlur:_DisconnectCamera()
    for _, conn in ipairs(self._cameraConnections) do
        conn:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._cameraConnections)
end

function AcrylicBlur:_ConnectCamera()
    self:_DisconnectCamera()

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return
    end

    local distance = BlurDefaults.CameraDistance or 0.0005
    local positions = {
        top_left = Vector2.new(),
        top_right = Vector2.new(),
        bottom_right = Vector2.new(),
    }

    local function ViewportToWorld(location, dist)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(location.X, location.Y)
        return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * dist
    end

    local function GetOffset()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            return BlurDefaults.FallbackOffset or 28
        end
        local viewY = cam.ViewportSize.Y
        return (viewY / (BlurDefaults.ReferenceViewportHeight or 2560))
                * (BlurDefaults.OffsetScale or 24)
            + (BlurDefaults.OffsetBase or 4)
    end

    local function UpdatePositions(size, position)
        positions.top_left = position
        positions.top_right = position + Vector2.new(size.X, 0)
        positions.bottom_right = position + size
    end

    local function Update()
        if not self._root or not self._enabled or self._destroyed then
            return
        end

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            return
        end

        local tl = ViewportToWorld(positions.top_left, distance)
        local tr = ViewportToWorld(positions.top_right, distance)
        local br = ViewportToWorld(positions.bottom_right, distance)

        local width = (tr - tl).Magnitude
        local height = (tr - br).Magnitude

        self._root.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(
            (tl + br) / 2,
            cam.CFrame.XVector,
            cam.CFrame.YVector,
            cam.CFrame.ZVector
        )
        self._root.Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(width, height, 0)
    end

    local function OnChange()
        if self._destroyed then
            return
        end
        local offset = GetOffset()
        local size = self._frame.AbsoluteSize - Vector2.new(offset, offset)
        local position = self._frame.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(offset / 2, offset / 2)
        UpdatePositions(size, position)
        task.spawn(Update)
    end

    self._renderUpdate = Update
    self._onChange = OnChange

    table.insert(self._cameraConnections, camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(Update))
    table.insert(
        self._cameraConnections,
        camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(Update)
    )
    table.insert(
        self._cameraConnections,
        camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FieldOfView"):Connect(Update)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(OnChange)
    )
    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(OnChange)
    )

    table.insert(self._connections, Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(Update))

    task.spawn(OnChange)
end

function AcrylicBlur:_StartRendering()
    self:_ConnectCamera()

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
            if not self._destroyed then
                self:_ReparentToCamera()
                self:_ConnectCamera()
            end
        end)
    )
end

function AcrylicBlur:_ReparentToCamera()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or not self._folder then
        return
    end

    self._folder.Parent = camera
end

function AcrylicBlur:_Initialize()
    self:_CreateEffects()
    self:_CreateMesh()
    self:_CreateTrackingFrame()
    self:_StartRendering()
end

function AcrylicBlur:SetEnabled(enabled)
    self._enabled = enabled

    if self._root then
        self._root.Transparency = if enabled
            then (BlurDefaults.RootTransparency or 0.9)
            else (BlurDefaults.DisabledTransparency or 1)
    end

    if self._dof then
        self._dof.Enabled = enabled
    end

    if self._blur then
        self._blur.Enabled = enabled
    end
end

--[[
    Destroys the blur effect and cleans up resources
]]
function AcrylicBlur:Destroy()
    if self._destroyed then
        return
    end
    self._destroyed = true

    self:_DisconnectCamera()

    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._folder then
        self._folder:Destroy()
    end

    if self._frame then
        self._frame:Destroy()
    end

    if self._dof then
        self._dof:Destroy()
    end

    if self._blur then
        self._blur:Destroy()
    end
end

return AcrylicBlur
end

__modules["Core.Notification"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Notification System

    Toast-style notifications with auto-dismiss.
]]

local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")

local Notification = {}
local NotificationDefaults = Defaults.Notification or {}
local NotificationIcons = Icons.Notification or {}
local NotificationSizes = Sizes.Notification or {}

local Containers= {}


--[[
    Creates the notification container

    @param screenGui ScreenGui - Parent screen gui
    @return Frame - Container frame
]]
function Notification.CreateContainer(screenGui)
    local existing = Containers[screenGui]
    if existing and existing.Parent == screenGui then
        return existing
    end
    Containers[screenGui] = nil

    local container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = NotificationDefaults.ContainerName or "NotificationContainer",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(NotificationSizes.RightOffset or 240),
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TopOffset or 20
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            NotificationSizes.Width or 220,
            1,
            -(NotificationSizes.VerticalPadding or 40)
        ),
        Parent = screenGui,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(container, NotificationSizes.Spacing or 10)
    Containers[screenGui] = container

    return container
end

function Notification.DestroyContainer(screenGui)
    local container = Containers[screenGui]
    if container then
        if container.Parent then
            container:Destroy()
        end
        Containers[screenGui] = nil
    end
end

--[[
    Shows a notification

    @param config NotificationConfig - Notification configuration
    @return Frame - Notification frame

    @example
    Notification.Show({
        Title = "Success",
        Description = "Operation completed!",
        Duration = 3,
        Icon = "rbxassetid://10709775704"
    }, screenGui)
]]
function Notification.Show(config, screenGui)
    if not screenGui then
        warn(
            NotificationDefaults.WarningUninitialized
                or "AcrylicUI: Notification container not initialized"
        )
        return nil
    end

    local container = Notification.CreateContainer(screenGui)

    local title = config.Title or NotificationDefaults.Title or "Notification"
    local description = config.Description or NotificationDefaults.Description or ""
    local duration = config.Duration or NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3
    local icon = config.Icon or NotificationIcons.Default or "rbxassetid://10709775704"

    -- Notification frame
    local notification = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = NotificationDefaults.InstanceName or "Notification",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Notification.Background,
        Position = UDim2.new(1, NotificationSizes.SlideOffset or 20, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, NotificationSizes.Height or Sizes.Notification.Height),
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Parent = container,
    })

    Create.Corner(notification, Sizes.Corner.Small)

    Create.Instance("UIStroke", {
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        Color = Colors.Notification.Border,
        Thickness = NotificationSizes.StrokeThickness or 1.5,
        Parent = notification,
    })

    -- Title
    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = title,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TextLeft or 14,
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TitleTop or 16
        ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(NotificationSizes.TextRightPadding or 60),
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TextHeight or 19
        ),
        Parent = notification,
    })

    -- Description
    Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Description",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = description,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TextLeft or 14,
            0,
            NotificationSizes.DescriptionTop or 38
        ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(NotificationSizes.TextRightPadding or 60),
            0,
            NotificationSizes.TextHeight or 19
        ),
        Parent = notification,
    })

    -- Icon
    local iconImage = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(NotificationSizes.IconRightOffset or 33),
            0,
            NotificationSizes.IconTop or 23
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, NotificationSizes.IconSize or 19, 0, NotificationSizes.IconSize or 19),
        Parent = notification,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(iconImage, icon, NotificationIcons.Default)

    Create.Instance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {
        Parent = iconImage,
    })

    -- Timer bar
    local timerBar = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Timer",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Notification.Timer,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -(NotificationSizes.TimerHeight or 3)),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, NotificationSizes.TimerHeight or 3),
        Parent = notification,
    })

    Create.Corner(timerBar, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Animate in
    Tween.Create(
        notification,
        { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) },
        NotificationDefaults.AnimationDuration or 0.3,
        Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
        Enum.EasingDirection.Out
    )

    -- Timer animation
    Tween.Create(
        timerBar,
        { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, NotificationSizes.TimerHeight or 3) },
        duration,
        Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
    )

    -- Auto dismiss
    task.delay(duration, function()
        Tween.CreateWithCallback(
            notification,
            { Position = UDim2.new(1, NotificationSizes.SlideOffset or 20, 0, 0) },
            NotificationDefaults.AnimationDuration or 0.3,
            function()
                notification:Destroy()
            end
        )
    end)

    return notification
end

return Notification
end

__modules["Core.Window"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Window Component

    The main window container with dragging, resizing, and minimize support.
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")
local Create = __require("Utils.Create")
local Tween = __require("Utils.Tween")
local Draggable = __require("Utils.Draggable")
local Device = __require("Utils.Device")
local Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
local Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
local Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
local Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")
local Layers = __require("Constants.Layers")

local AcrylicBlur = __require("Core.AcrylicBlur")
local Notification = __require("Core.Notification")

local Window = {}
Window.__index = Window

local function safeGet(name)
    local sources = {}

    local ok, env = pcall(function()
        local genv = rawget(_G, "getgenv")
        if type(genv) == "function" then
            return genv()
        end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and type(env) == "table" then
        table.insert(sources, env)
    end

    ok, env = pcall(function()
        if type(getfenv) == "function" then
            return getfenv()
        end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and type(env) == "table" then
        table.insert(sources, env)
    end

    table.insert(sources, _G)

    for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
        local fn = src[name]
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            return fn
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local writeFile = safeGet("writefile")
local readFile = safeGet("readfile")
local isFile = safeGet("isfile")
local makeFolder = safeGet("makefolder")
local isFolder = safeGet("isfolder")
local listFiles = safeGet("listfiles")
local deleteFile = safeGet("delfile")


local WindowDefaults = Defaults.Window or {}
local ConfigDefaults = Defaults.Config or {}
local NotificationDefaults = Defaults.Notification or {}
local MessageDefaults = Defaults.Messages or {}
local CommonDefaults = Defaults.Components and Defaults.Components.Common or {}
local WindowIcons = Icons.Window or {}
local NotificationIcons = Icons.Notification or {}
local WindowLayers = Layers.Window or {}
local WindowChromeSizes = Sizes.WindowChrome or {}
local CONFIG_ROOT = ConfigDefaults.Root or "AcrylicConfigs"
local AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME = ConfigDefaults.AutoLoadName or "_autoload"
local CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME = ConfigDefaults.DefaultName or "default"
local CONFIG_EXTENSION = ConfigDefaults.Extension or ".json"
local CONFIG_EXTENSION_PATTERN = CONFIG_EXTENSION:gsub("(%W)", "%%%1")

local function SanitizeConfigName(configName)
    local sanitized = tostring(configName or CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME)
    sanitized = sanitized:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    sanitized = sanitized:gsub("%.%.", "_")
    sanitized = sanitized:gsub('[%/%\\%*%?"<>|:]', "_")
    sanitized = sanitized:gsub("^%.+", ""):gsub("%.+$", "")

    if sanitized == "" then
        sanitized = CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME
    end

    return sanitized
end

local function GetConfigFolder(configFolder)
    return CONFIG_ROOT .. "/" .. SanitizeConfigName(configFolder)
end

local function GetConfigPath(configFolder, configName)
    return GetConfigFolder(configFolder)
        .. "/"
        .. SanitizeConfigName(configName)
        .. CONFIG_EXTENSION
end

local function GetAutoLoadPath(configFolder)
    return GetConfigFolder(configFolder) .. "/" .. AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME .. CONFIG_EXTENSION
end

local function EnsureConfigFolder(configFolder)
    if not makeFolder then
        return
    end

    if not isFolder or not isFolder(CONFIG_ROOT) then
        pcall(makeFolder, CONFIG_ROOT)
    end

    local folder = GetConfigFolder(configFolder)
    if not isFolder or not isFolder(folder) then
        pcall(makeFolder, folder)
    end
end

local function SerializeValue(value)
    local valueType = typeof(value)

    if valueType == "Color3" then
        return {
            _type = "Color3",
            R = value.R,
            G = value.G,
            B = value.B,
        }
    end

    if valueType == "EnumItem" then
        return {
            _type = "EnumItem",
            EnumType = tostring(value.EnumType),
            Name = value.Name,
        }
    end

    return value
end

local function DeserializeValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return value
    end

    if value._type == "Color3" then
        return Color3.new(value.R, value.G, value.B)
    end

    if value._type == "EnumItem" then
        local enumName = tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.", "")
        local enumType = Enum[enumName]
        if enumType and enumType[value.Name] then
            return enumType[value.Name]
        end
    end

    return value
end

local function ResolveWindowSizes(requestedSize, clampToViewport)
    local maxWidth = Sizes.MaxWindow.Width
    local maxHeight = Sizes.MaxWindow.Height

    if clampToViewport then
        local viewport = Device.GetViewportSize()
        local margin = Device.IsMobile() and (WindowChromeSizes.MobileViewportMargin or 24)
            or (WindowChromeSizes.DesktopViewportMargin or 40)
        maxWidth = math.max(WindowChromeSizes.MinMobileWidth or 320, viewport.X - margin)
        maxHeight = math.max(WindowChromeSizes.MinMobileHeight or 240, viewport.Y - margin)
    end

    local defaultWidth = requestedSize and requestedSize.Width or Sizes.Window.Width
    local defaultHeight = requestedSize and requestedSize.Height or Sizes.Window.Height

    if Device.IsMobile() then
        defaultWidth = math.min(defaultWidth, maxWidth)
        defaultHeight = math.min(defaultHeight, maxHeight)
    end

    local minWidth = math.min(Sizes.MinWindow.Width, maxWidth)
    local minHeight = math.min(Sizes.MinWindow.Height, maxHeight)
    local resolvedMaxWidth = math.min(Sizes.MaxWindow.Width, maxWidth)
    local resolvedMaxHeight = math.min(Sizes.MaxWindow.Height, maxHeight)

    minWidth = math.min(minWidth, resolvedMaxWidth)
    minHeight = math.min(minHeight, resolvedMaxHeight)

    return {
        Width = math.clamp(defaultWidth, minWidth, resolvedMaxWidth),
        Height = math.clamp(defaultHeight, minHeight, resolvedMaxHeight),
    }, {
        Width = minWidth,
        Height = minHeight,
    }, {
        Width = resolvedMaxWidth,
        Height = resolvedMaxHeight,
    }
end

--[[
    Creates a new window

    @param config WindowConfig - Window configuration
    @return Window - Window instance

    @example
    local window = Window.new({
        Title = "My Hub",
        Size = { Width = 700, Height = 450 },
        ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
    })
]]
function Window.new(config)
    config = config or {}
    local self = setmetatable({}, Window)

    -- Apply theme overrides before building UI
    if config.Theme then
        Colors:SetTheme(config.Theme)
    end

    local clampToViewport = if config.ClampToViewport == nil
        then (WindowDefaults.ClampToViewport ~= false)
        else config.ClampToViewport
    local resolvedSize, minSize, maxSize = ResolveWindowSizes(config.Size, clampToViewport)

    self._title = config.Title or WindowDefaults.Title or "AcrylicUI"
    self._size = resolvedSize
    self._minSize = minSize
    self._maxSize = maxSize
    self._toggleKey = config.ToggleKey or WindowDefaults.ToggleKey or Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
    self._configFolder = SanitizeConfigName(config.ConfigFolder or self._title)
    self._visible = true
    self._minimized = false
    self._sections = {}
    self._keybinds = {}
    self._configElements = {}
    self._connections = {}
    self._currentTab = nil
    self._originalHeight = self._size.Height
    self._autoSave = false
    self._autoSaveThreadRunning = false
    self._currentConfig = CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME
    self._destroyed = false
    self._autoLoad = false
    self._autoLoadConfigName = CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME
    self._pendingConfigData = nil
    self:_LoadAutoLoadState()

    self:_CreateGui()
    self:_SetupKeybinds()

    if Device.IsMobile() then
        self:_SetupMobileToggle()
    end

    if self._autoLoad then
        self:ApplyAutoLoad()
    end

    return self
end

function Window:_CreateGui()
    local player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer
    local coreGuiAvailable, coreGui = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)

    -- Screen GUI
    self._screenGui = Create.Instance("ScreenGui", {
        Name = WindowDefaults.ScreenGuiName or "AcrylicUI",
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
    })

    local parentedToCoreGui = false
    if coreGuiAvailable and coreGui then
        parentedToCoreGui = pcall(function()
            self._screenGui.Parent = coreGui
        end)
    end

    if not parentedToCoreGui then
        self._screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    -- Main container
    self._container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Container",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -self._size.Width / 2, 0.5, -self._size.Height / 2),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, self._size.Width, 0, self._size.Height),
        ClipsDescendants = false,
        Parent = self._screenGui,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._container, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._container)

    -- Title
    self._titleLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = self._title,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, WindowChromeSizes.TitleX or 10, 0, WindowChromeSizes.TitleY or 10),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Title,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.TitleWidth or 150,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.TitleHeight or 25
        ),
        ZIndex = 1,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    -- Topbar drag area (covers full topbar minus the controls frame).
    self._topBarDragArea = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "TopBarDragArea",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(WindowChromeSizes.TopBarControlsWidth or 80),
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.HeaderHeight or 45
        ),
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.TopBarDragArea or 5,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    self:_CreateContentArea()
    -- Controls are created after content so resize stays above scroll layers.
    self:_CreateWindowControls()

    -- Make draggable
    self._dragConnection = Draggable.Enable(self._container, self._topBarDragArea)
    self._bottomDragConnection = Draggable.Enable(self._container, self._bottomDragArea)

    -- Acrylic blur effect. Some executors block 3D/effect properties; keep UI alive without blur.
    local blurOk, blur = pcall(AcrylicBlur.new, self._container)
    if blurOk then
        self._acrylicBlur = blur
    else
        self._acrylicBlur = nil
        warn("[AcrylicUI] Acrylic blur disabled: " .. tostring(blur))
    end

    -- Notification container
    Notification.CreateContainer(self._screenGui)
end

function Window:_CreateWindowControls()
    -- Topbar controls frame (excluded from the topbar drag area).
    self._topBarControls = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "TopBarControls",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.TopBarControlsWidth or 80,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.HeaderHeight or 45
        ),
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.TopBarControls or 6,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    -- Minimize button
    local minimizeBtn = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Minimize",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(WindowChromeSizes.MinimizeRightOffset or 35),
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlTop or 15
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlSize or 15,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlSize or 15
        ),
        Parent = self._topBarControls,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(minimizeBtn, nil, WindowIcons.Minimize)

    local minimizeClick = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ClickArea",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.MinimizeClickWidth or 21,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlSize or 15
        ),
        Parent = minimizeBtn,
    })

    minimizeClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self:_ToggleMinimize()
    end)

    minimizeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Tween.Create(minimizeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    end)

    minimizeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Tween.Create(minimizeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    end)

    -- Close button
    local closeBtn = Create.Instance("ImageButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(WindowChromeSizes.CloseRightOffset or 10),
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlTop or 15
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlSize or 15,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ControlSize or 15
        ),
        Parent = self._topBarControls,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(closeBtn, nil, WindowIcons.Close)

    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self:Destroy()
    end)

    closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Tween.Create(closeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.CloseHover }, "Fast")
    end)

    closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Tween.Create(closeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    end)

    -- Resize handle
    self._resizeBtn = Create.Instance("ImageButton", {
        Name = "Resize",
        Active = true,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.ResizeHandle,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(WindowChromeSizes.ResizeOffset or 5),
            1,
            -(WindowChromeSizes.ResizeOffset or 5)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ResizeWidth or 62,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.ResizeHeight or 60
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.ResizeHandle or 1000,
        Parent = self._container,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._resizeBtn, nil, WindowIcons.Resize)

    -- Bottom drag handle
    self._bottomDragArea = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "BottomDragArea",
        Active = true,
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragWidth or 140,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragHeight or 18
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.BottomDragArea or 1000,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    self._bottomDragBar = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "BottomDragBar",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.ResizeHandle,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarTop or 4.5),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarWidth or 90,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarHeight or 4
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.BottomDragBar or 1001,
        Parent = self._bottomDragArea,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._bottomDragBar, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    self:_SetupResize()
    self:_SetupBottomDragHandle()
end

function Window:_CreateContentArea()
    -- Header separator
    Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "HeaderSeparator",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, WindowChromeSizes.HeaderHeight or 45),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    -- Main content area
    self._mainContent = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "MainContent",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, WindowChromeSizes.ContentTop or 46),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(WindowChromeSizes.ContentTop or 46)),
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    -- Sections sidebar
    self._sectionsContainer = Create.Instance("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "Sections",
        ScrollBarThickness = 0,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, WindowChromeSizes.SidebarWidth or 165, 1, 0),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        Parent = self._mainContent,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._sectionsContainer, 0)
    Create.Padding(self._sectionsContainer, 5, 5, 5, 5)

    -- Separator
    Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Separator",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, WindowChromeSizes.SidebarWidth or 165, 0, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._mainContent,
    })

    -- Content area
    self._contentContainer = Create.Instance("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "Content",
        ScrollBarThickness = WindowChromeSizes.ContentScrollbarThickness or 3,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = Colors.Scrollbar,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, WindowChromeSizes.ContentLeft or 166, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(WindowChromeSizes.ContentLeft or 166), 1, 0),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        Parent = self._mainContent,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._contentContainer, 8)
    Create.Padding(self._contentContainer, 10, 10, 15, 15)

    self._popupLayer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "PopupLayer",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        ZIndex = WindowLayers.PopupLayer or 900,
        Parent = self._mainContent,
    })
end

function Window:_SetupResize()
    local resizing = false
    local startSize, startInput, lastPos

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._resizeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Tween.Create(self._resizeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._resizeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not resizing then
                Tween.Create(self._resizeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.ResizeHandle }, "Fast")
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._resizeBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            then
                resizing = true
                startSize = self._container.AbsoluteSize
                startInput = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                lastPos = startInput
                self._originalHeight = startSize.Y

                local renderConn
                renderConn = Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    if not resizing then
                        return
                    end
                    local currentPos = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                    if currentPos == lastPos then
                        return
                    end
                    lastPos = currentPos

                    local delta = currentPos - startInput
                    local newWidth =
                        math.clamp(startSize.X + delta.X, self._minSize.Width, self._maxSize.Width)
                    local newHeight = math.clamp(
                        startSize.Y + delta.Y,
                        self._minSize.Height,
                        self._maxSize.Height
                    )

                    self._container.Size = UDim2.new(0, newWidth, 0, newHeight)
                    self._originalHeight = newHeight
                end)
                table.insert(self._connections, renderConn)

                local resizeInput = input
                local endConn
                endConn = Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endInput)
                    if endInput == resizeInput then
                        resizing = false
                        renderConn:Disconnect()
                        Tween.Create(self._resizeBtn, { ImageColor3 = Colors.ResizeHandle }, "Fast")
                        endConn:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(self._connections, endConn)
            end
        end)
    )
end

function Window:_SetupBottomDragHandle()
    local hovering = false
    local holding = false

    local function update()
        local color = (hovering or holding) and Colors.Text or Colors.ResizeHandle
