        local height = holding and (WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarHoldingHeight or 5.5)
            or (WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarHeight or 4)

        Tween.Create(self._bottomDragBar, {
            BackgroundColor3 = color,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, WindowChromeSizes.BottomDragBarWidth or 90, 0, height),
        }, "Fast")
    end

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._bottomDragArea.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            hovering = true
            update()
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._bottomDragArea.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            hovering = false
            update()
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._bottomDragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            then
                holding = true
                update()

                local holdInput = input
                local connection
                connection = Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endInput)
                    if endInput == holdInput then
                        holding = false
                        update()
                        connection:Disconnect()
                    end
                end)

                table.insert(self._connections, connection)
            end
        end)
    )
end

function Window:_ToggleMinimize()
    self._minimized = not self._minimized

    if self._minimized then
        Tween.Create(self._mainContent, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }, "Slow")
        Tween.Create(self._container, {
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                self._container.AbsoluteSize.X,
                0,
                WindowChromeSizes.HeaderHeight or 45
            ),
        }, "Slow")
        self._resizeBtn.Visible = false
        self._bottomDragArea.Visible = false
    else
        Tween.Create(self._container, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, self._container.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, self._originalHeight),
        }, "Slow")
        task.delay(WindowDefaults.MinimizeRestoreDelay or 0.1, function()
            Tween.Create(
                self._mainContent,
                { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(WindowChromeSizes.ContentTop or 46)) },
                "Normal"
            )
        end)
        self._resizeBtn.Visible = true
        self._bottomDragArea.Visible = true
    end
end

function Window:_SetupKeybinds()
    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
            if gameProcessed then
                return
            end

            if input.KeyCode == self._toggleKey then
                self:Toggle()
            end

            for _, keybindData in pairs(self._keybinds) do
                if input.KeyCode == keybindData.key then
                    keybindData.callback()
                end
            end
        end)
    )
end

function Window:_SetupMobileToggle()
    self._mobileToggle = Create.Instance("ImageButton", {
        Name = "MobileToggle",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.Text,
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.MobileToggleX or 15,
            0.5,
            WindowChromeSizes.MobileToggleYOffset or -25
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.MobileToggleSize or 50,
            0,
            WindowChromeSizes.MobileToggleSize or 50
        ),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Visible = false,
        Parent = self._screenGui,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._mobileToggle, nil, WindowIcons.MobileToggle)

    Create.Corner(self._mobileToggle, WindowChromeSizes.MobileToggleCorner or 25)
    Create.Stroke(self._mobileToggle)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart
    local startPos

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._mobileToggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = self._mobileToggle.Position
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        self._mobileToggle.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            then
                if dragging and dragStart then
                    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                    if delta.Magnitude < (WindowChromeSizes.MobileTapThreshold or 10) then
                        self:Toggle()
                    end
                end
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    )

    table.insert(
        self._connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if
                dragging
                and dragStart
                and startPos
                and (
                    input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                )
            then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                self._mobileToggle.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    )
end

--[[
    Toggles window visibility
]]
function Window:Toggle()
    self._visible = not self._visible
    self._container.Visible = self._visible

    if self._acrylicBlur then
        self._acrylicBlur:SetEnabled(self._visible)
    end

    if self._mobileToggle then
        self._mobileToggle.Visible = not self._visible
    end
end

--[[
    Sets the toggle key for showing/hiding the window

    @param keyCode Enum.KeyCode - The key to use
]]
function Window:SetToggleKey(keyCode)
    self._toggleKey = keyCode
end

--[[
    Shows a notification

    @param config NotificationConfig - Notification configuration
]]
function Window:Notify(config)
    return Notification.Show(config, self._screenGui)
end

--[[
    Creates a new section in the sidebar

    @param name string - Section name
    @return Section - Section instance
]]
function Window:CreateSection(name)
    local Section = __require("Components.Section")
    local section = Section.new(self, name)
    table.insert(self._sections, section)
    return section
end

--[[
    Selects a tab

    @param tab Tab - The tab to select
]]
function Window:SelectTab(tab)
    if self._currentTab then
        self._currentTab:Deselect()
    end

    self._currentTab = tab
    tab:Select()
end

--[[
    Registers a keybind

    @param id string - Unique identifier
    @param key Enum.KeyCode - The key
    @param callback function - Callback function
]]
function Window:RegisterKeybind(id, key, callback)
    self._keybinds[id] = {
        key = key,
        callback = callback,
    }
end

function Window:UnregisterKeybind(id)
    self._keybinds[id] = nil
end

--[[
    Updates a registered keybind

    @param id string - Keybind identifier
    @param key Enum.KeyCode - New key
]]
function Window:UpdateKeybind(id, key)
    if self._keybinds[id] then
        self._keybinds[id].key = key
    end
end

function Window:RegisterConfigElement(
    flag,
    elementType,
    getValue,
    setValue
)
    local sanitizedFlag = SanitizeConfigName(flag)
    self._configElements[sanitizedFlag] = {
        type = elementType,
        getValue = getValue,
        setValue = setValue,
    }

    if self._pendingConfigData and self._pendingConfigData[sanitizedFlag] ~= nil then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            setValue(DeserializeValue(self._pendingConfigData[sanitizedFlag]))
        end)
        if not success then
            warn(
                string.format(
                    "[AcrylicUI] Failed to apply pending config '%s': %s",
                    sanitizedFlag,
                    tostring(err)
                )
            )
        end
        self._pendingConfigData[sanitizedFlag] = nil
    end
end

function Window:UnregisterConfigElement(flag)
    self._configElements[SanitizeConfigName(flag)] = nil
end

function Window:SaveConfig(configName)
    if not writeFile then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigSystemUnsupported or "Config system not supported",
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    local sanitizedName = SanitizeConfigName(configName or self._currentConfig)

    if sanitizedName == AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigReservedName or "Name reserved for internal use",
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    EnsureConfigFolder(self._configFolder)

    local configData = {}
    for flag, element in pairs(self._configElements) do
        configData[flag] = SerializeValue(element.getValue())
    end

    local success = pcall(function()
        writeFile(
            GetConfigPath(self._configFolder, sanitizedName),
            Services.HttpService:JSONEncode(configData)
        )
    end)

    if success then
        self._currentConfig = sanitizedName
        if self._autoLoad then
            self._autoLoadConfigName = sanitizedName
            self:_SaveAutoLoadState()
        end
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ConfigSavedTitle or "Config Saved",
            Description = (MessageDefaults.ConfigSavedDescriptionPrefix or "Saved as: ")
                .. sanitizedName,
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.SuccessDuration or 2,
            Icon = NotificationIcons.Config or "rbxassetid://10723356507",
        })
        return true
    end

    self:Notify({
        Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
        Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigSaveFailed or "Failed to save config",
        Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
    })
    return false
end

function Window:LoadConfig(configName)
    if not readFile or not isFile then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigSystemUnsupported or "Config system not supported",
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    local sanitizedName = SanitizeConfigName(configName or self._currentConfig)

    if sanitizedName == AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigReservedName or "Name reserved for internal use",
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    local path = GetConfigPath(self._configFolder, sanitizedName)

    if not isFile(path) then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = (MessageDefaults.ConfigNotFoundPrefix or "Config not found: ")
                .. sanitizedName,
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readFile(path))
    end)

    if not success or type(data) ~= "table" then
        self:Notify({
            Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
            Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigLoadFailed or "Failed to load config",
            Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
        })
        return false
    end

    for flag, value in pairs(data) do
        local element = self._configElements[flag]
        if element then
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                element.setValue(DeserializeValue(value))
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn(
                    string.format(
                        "[AcrylicUI] Failed to apply config '%s' for element '%s': %s",
                        flag,
                        tostring(element.type or "?"),
                        tostring(err)
                    )
                )
            end
        else
            if not self._pendingConfigData then
                self._pendingConfigData = {}
            end
            self._pendingConfigData[flag] = value
        end
    end

    self._currentConfig = sanitizedName
    if self._autoLoad then
        self._autoLoadConfigName = sanitizedName
        self:_SaveAutoLoadState()
    end
    self:Notify({
        Title = MessageDefaults.ConfigLoadedTitle or "Config Loaded",
        Description = (MessageDefaults.ConfigLoadedDescriptionPrefix or "Loaded: ")
            .. sanitizedName,
        Duration = NotificationDefaults.SuccessDuration or 2,
        Icon = NotificationIcons.Config or "rbxassetid://10723356507",
    })
    return true
end

function Window:DeleteConfig(configName)
    if not deleteFile or not isFile then
        return false
    end

    local sanitizedName = SanitizeConfigName(configName or self._currentConfig)

    if sanitizedName == AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME then
        return false
    end

    local path = GetConfigPath(self._configFolder, sanitizedName)

    if not isFile(path) then
        return false
    end

    deleteFile(path)
    self:Notify({
        Title = MessageDefaults.ConfigDeletedTitle or "Config Deleted",
        Description = (MessageDefaults.ConfigDeletedDescriptionPrefix or "Deleted: ")
            .. sanitizedName,
        Duration = NotificationDefaults.SuccessDuration or 2,
    })
    return true
end

function Window:GetConfigs()
    local configs = {}
    if not listFiles or not isFolder then
        return configs
    end

    EnsureConfigFolder(self._configFolder)

    local folder = GetConfigFolder(self._configFolder)
    if not isFolder(folder) then
        return configs
    end

    for _, file in ipairs(listFiles(folder)) do
        local fileName = file:match("[^/\\]+$") or file
        local configName = fileName:match("(.+)" .. CONFIG_EXTENSION_PATTERN .. "$")
        if configName and configName ~= AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME then
            table.insert(configs, configName)
        end
    end

    table.sort(configs)
    return configs
end

function Window:SetAutoSave(enabled)
    self._autoSave = enabled

    if not enabled or self._autoSaveThreadRunning then
        return
    end

    self._autoSaveThreadRunning = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while
            self._autoSave
            and not self._destroyed
            and self._screenGui
            and self._screenGui.Parent
        do
            task.wait(WindowDefaults.AutoSaveInterval or 30)
            if self._autoSave and not self._destroyed then
                self:SaveConfig(self._currentConfig)
            end
        end
        self._autoSaveThreadRunning = false
    end)
end

--[[
    Enables or disables auto-load (persists config across sessions)

    @param enabled boolean - Whether to auto-load on startup
]]
function Window:SetAutoLoad(enabled)
    if enabled then
        local sanitizedName = SanitizeConfigName(self._currentConfig)
        if sanitizedName == AUTOLOAD_CONFIG_NAME then
            sanitizedName = CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME
        end

        local path = GetConfigPath(self._configFolder, sanitizedName)
        if readFile and isFile and not isFile(path) then
            self:Notify({
                Title = MessageDefaults.ErrorTitle or "Error",
                Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigAutoLoadNeedsConfig
                    or "Save or load a config before enabling Auto Load",
                Duration = NotificationDefaults.Duration or 3,
            })
            return false
        end

        self._autoLoadConfigName = sanitizedName
    end

    self._autoLoad = enabled
    self:_SaveAutoLoadState()
    return true
end

--[[
    Returns whether auto-load is enabled

    @return boolean - Current auto-load state
]]
function Window:GetAutoLoad()
    return self._autoLoad
end

--[[
    Applies auto-load: loads the last saved config if auto-load is enabled
]]
function Window:ApplyAutoLoad()
    if not self._autoLoad or not readFile or not isFile then
        return
    end

    local path = GetConfigPath(self._configFolder, self._autoLoadConfigName)
    if isFile(path) then
        self:LoadConfig(self._autoLoadConfigName)
    end
end

--[[
    Saves the current auto-load state to a file
]]
function Window:_SaveAutoLoadState()
    if not writeFile then
        return
    end

    EnsureConfigFolder(self._configFolder)
    local path = GetAutoLoadPath(self._configFolder)

    local data = {
        enabled = self._autoLoad,
        lastConfig = self._autoLoadConfigName,
    }

    pcall(function()
        writeFile(path, Services.HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
    end)
end

--[[
    Loads the auto-load state from file
]]
function Window:_LoadAutoLoadState()
    if not readFile or not isFile then
        return
    end

    local path = GetAutoLoadPath(self._configFolder)
    if not isFile(path) then
        return
    end

    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readFile(path))
    end)

    if success and type(data) == "table" then
        self._autoLoad = if data.enabled == true then true else false
        self._autoLoadConfigName = tostring(data.lastConfig or CONFIG_DEFAULT_NAME)
    end
end

--[[
    Gets the content container for tabs

    @return ScrollingFrame
]]
function Window:GetContentContainer()
    return self._contentContainer
end

--[[
    Gets the sections container

    @return ScrollingFrame
]]
function Window:GetSectionsContainer()
    return self._sectionsContainer
end

function Window:GetPopupLayer()
    return self._popupLayer
end

function Window:Destroy()
    if self._destroyed then
        return
    end

    self._destroyed = true
    self._autoSave = false

    for _, section in ipairs(self._sections) do
        if section.Destroy then
            pcall(function()
                section:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._sections)

    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        if typeof(connection) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)

    if self._dragConnection then
        self._dragConnection.Disconnect()
    end

    if self._bottomDragConnection then
        self._bottomDragConnection.Disconnect()
    end

    if self._acrylicBlur then
        self._acrylicBlur:Destroy()
    end

    if self._screenGui then
        Notification.DestroyContainer(self._screenGui)
    end

    if self._screenGui then
        self._screenGui:Destroy()
    end

    table.clear(self._keybinds)
    table.clear(self._configElements)
end

return Window
end

__modules["init"] = function()
--[[
     Version: 2.0.0
     License: MIT


    @module AcrylicUI
    @author AcrylicUI Team
    @version 2.0.0

    @example
    local AcrylicUI = require(path.to.AcrylicUI)

    local window = AcrylicUI.CreateWindow({
        Title = "My Hub",
        ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
    })

    local section = window:CreateSection("Combat")
    local tab = section:CreateTab("Aimbot", "rbxassetid://10723407389")

    tab:Toggle({
        Name = "Enable Aimbot",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(enabled)
            print("Aimbot:", enabled)
        end
    })
]]

local AcrylicUI = {}
AcrylicUI.__index = AcrylicUI

-- Version info
AcrylicUI.Version = "2.0.0"
AcrylicUI.Author = "Arcylic-Modded"

-- Core modules
local Window = __require("Core.Window")

-- Constants (exposed for customization)
AcrylicUI.Colors = __require("Constants.Colors")
AcrylicUI.Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes")
AcrylicUI.Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts")
AcrylicUI.Animation = __require("Constants.Animation")
AcrylicUI.Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")
AcrylicUI.Icons = __require("Constants.Icons")
AcrylicUI.Layers = __require("Constants.Layers")

-- Utilities (exposed for advanced usage)
AcrylicUI.Utils = {
    Create = __require("Utils.Create"),
    Tween = __require("Utils.Tween"),
    Draggable = __require("Utils.Draggable"),
    Device = __require("Utils.Device"),
}

--[[
    Creates a new window

    @param config WindowConfig - Configuration options
    @return Window - The created window instance

    @example
    local window = AcrylicUI.CreateWindow({
        Title = "My Hub",
        Size = { Width = 700, Height = 450 },
        ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
    })
]]
function AcrylicUI.CreateWindow(config)
    return Window.new(config)
end

function AcrylicUI.new(title, configFolder)
    return Window.new({
        Title = title,
        ConfigFolder = configFolder,
    })
end

--[[
    Applies a partial theme override to all UI components.

    @param overrides table - Color overrides
    @example
    AcrylicUI:SetTheme({ Accent = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255) })
]]
function AcrylicUI.SetTheme(overrides)
    AcrylicUI.Colors:SetTheme(overrides)
end

--[[
    Restores all theme colors to the factory defaults.
]]
function AcrylicUI.ResetTheme()
    AcrylicUI.Colors:ResetTheme()
end

--[[
    Returns a standalone snapshot of the current theme.

    @return table - Current color values
]]
function AcrylicUI.GetTheme()
    return AcrylicUI.Colors:Snapshot()
end

--[[
    Gets library information

    @return table - Library info
]]
function AcrylicUI.GetInfo()
    return {
        Version = AcrylicUI.Version,
        Author = AcrylicUI.Author,
        Components = {
            "Window",
            "Section",
            "Tab",
            "Button",
            "Toggle",
            "Slider",
            "Dropdown",
            "Keybind",
            "ColorPicker",
            "TextBox",
            "Paragraph",
            "Notification",
        },
    }
end

return AcrylicUI
end

__modules["Utils.Create"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Instance Creation Utilities

    Helper functions for creating and configuring UI instances.
]]

local Constants = {
    Colors = __require("Constants.Colors"),
    Sizes = __require("Constants.Sizes"),
    Fonts = __require("Constants.Fonts"),
    Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults"),
    Layers = __require("Constants.Layers"),
}

local IconResolver = __require("Utils.IconResolver")

local Create = {}

--[[
    Creates a new instance with properties

    @param className string - The class name of the instance
    @param properties table - Properties to apply
    @return Instance - The created instance

    @example
    local frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Container",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = screenGui
    })
]]
function Create.Instance(className, properties)
    local instance = Instance.new(className)

    for property, value in pairs(properties) do
        if property ~= "Parent" then
            if property == "Name" then
                instance[property] = "\0"
            else
                instance[property] = value
            end
        end
    end

    -- Set parent last to avoid unnecessary property updates
    if properties.Parent then
        instance.Parent = properties.Parent
    end

    return instance
end

--[[
    Creates a UICorner with specified radius

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach corner to
    @param radius number? - Corner radius in pixels (default: 5)
    @return UICorner
]]
function Create.Corner(parent, radius)
    return Create.Instance("UICorner", {
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or Constants.Sizes.Corner.Medium),
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

--[[
    Creates a UIStroke border

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach stroke to
    @param color Color3? - Stroke color (default: Border color)
    @param transparency number? - Stroke transparency (default: 0)
    @param thickness number? - Stroke thickness (default: 1)
    @return UIStroke
]]
function Create.Stroke(
    parent,
    color,
    transparency,
    thickness
)
    return Create.Instance("UIStroke", {
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        Color = color or Constants.Colors.Border,
        Transparency = transparency or 0,
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

--[[
    Creates a UIPadding

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach padding to
    @param top number? - Top padding
    @param bottom number? - Bottom padding
    @param left number? - Left padding
    @param right number? - Right padding
    @return UIPadding
]]
function Create.Padding(
    parent,
    top,
    bottom,
    left,
    right
)
    return Create.Instance("UIPadding", {
        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, top or 0),
        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom or 0),
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, left or 0),
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, right or 0),
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

--[[
    Creates a UIListLayout

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach layout to
    @param padding number? - Padding between elements
    @param sortOrder Enum.SortOrder? - Sort order
    @param direction Enum.FillDirection? - Fill direction
    @return UIListLayout
]]
function Create.ListLayout(
    parent,
    padding,
    sortOrder,
    direction
)
    return Create.Instance("UIListLayout", {
        Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 0),
        SortOrder = sortOrder or Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

--[[
    Creates a UIGridLayout

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach layout to
    @param cellSize UDim2 - Size of each cell
    @param cellPadding UDim2? - Padding between cells
    @return UIGridLayout
]]
function Create.GridLayout(parent, cellSize, cellPadding)
    return Create.Instance("UIGridLayout", {
        CellSize = cellSize,
        CellPadding = cellPadding or UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

function Create.GetDescription(config)
    if not config then
        return nil
    end

    local description = config.Description or config.Desc
    if description == nil or description == "" then
        return nil
    end

    return tostring(description)
end

--[[
    Applies an icon string to an ImageLabel.

    Accepts:
        "rbxassetid://..."  -> direct asset
        "pack/name"         -> resolved via IconResolver
        nil / "" / unknown  -> hides the label (or applies fallbackIcon)

    @param imageLabel ImageLabel - target
    @param icon string? - the user-supplied icon string
    @param fallbackIcon string? - optional rbxassetid to use when pack
        resolution fails or the input is missing
    @return boolean - true if an icon was applied, false if hidden
]]
function Create.ApplyIcon(imageLabel, icon, fallbackIcon)
    if imageLabel == nil then
        return false
    end

    if icon == nil or icon == "" then
        if fallbackIcon and fallbackIcon ~= "" then
            imageLabel.Image = fallbackIcon
            imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
            imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
            imageLabel.Visible = true
            return true
        end
        imageLabel.Visible = false
        return false
    end

    if IconResolver.IsAsset(icon) then
        imageLabel.Image = icon
        imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.Visible = true
        return true
    end

    local resolved = IconResolver.Resolve(icon)
    if resolved and resolved.Image then
        imageLabel.Image = resolved.Image
        imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = resolved.ImageRectOffset or Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.ImageRectSize = resolved.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.Visible = true
        return true
    end

    if fallbackIcon and fallbackIcon ~= "" then
        imageLabel.Image = fallbackIcon
        imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
        imageLabel.Visible = true
        return true
    end

    imageLabel.Visible = false
    return false
end

function Create.Description(
    parent,
    text,
    position,
    size
)
    if not text then
        return nil
    end

    return Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Description",
        FontFace = Constants.Fonts.Light,
        TextColor3 = Constants.Colors.TextDark,
        Text = text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Constants.Fonts.Size.Tiny,
        Position = position,
        Size = size,
        Parent = parent,
    })
end

function Create.Blockable(target, frame)
    target._blocked = false
    local messages = Constants.Defaults.Messages or {}
    local commonDefaults = Constants.Defaults.Components and Constants.Defaults.Components.Common
        or {}
    local blockerLayers = Constants.Layers.Blocker or {}

    target._blocker = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Blocker",
        Text = commonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        Active = true,
        BackgroundColor3 = Constants.Colors.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = commonDefaults.BlockerTransparency or 0.22,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = blockerLayers.Overlay or 1000,
        Parent = frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(target._blocker, Constants.Sizes.Corner.Medium)

    target._blockerLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "BlockerLabel",
        FontFace = Constants.Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Constants.Colors.Text,
        Text = messages.Blocked or "Blocked",
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Constants.Fonts.Size.Small,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
        ZIndex = blockerLayers.Label or 1001,
        Parent = target._blocker,
    })

    function target:Block(text)
        local blockText = if text == nil or tostring(text) == ""
            then (messages.Blocked or "Blocked")
            else tostring(text)
        self._blocked = true
        self._blockerLabel.Text = blockText
        self._blocker.Visible = true
    end

    function target:Unblock()
        self._blocked = false
        self._blocker.Visible = false
    end

    function target:IsBlocked()
        return self._blocked == true
    end
end

return Create
end

__modules["Utils.Device"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Device Detection Utility

    Detects device type and capabilities.
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")
local Defaults = __require("Constants.Defaults")

local Device = {}
local DeviceDefaults = Defaults.Device or {}
local DEFAULT_VIEWPORT = DeviceDefaults.DefaultViewport or Vector2.new(1280, 720)

--[[
    Checks if the current device is mobile (touch only)

    @return boolean - True if mobile device
]]
function Device.IsMobile()
    return Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is a tablet

    @return boolean - True if tablet device
]]
function Device.IsTablet()
    local viewport = Device.GetViewportSize()
    return Device.IsMobile()
        and math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) >= (DeviceDefaults.TabletMinShortSide or 600)
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is a console

    @return boolean - True if console device
]]
function Device.IsConsole()
    return Services.UserInputService.GamepadEnabled
        and not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
        and not Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is desktop

    @return boolean - True if desktop device
]]
function Device.IsDesktop()
    return Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and Services.UserInputService.MouseEnabled
end

--[[
    Gets the safe area insets (for notched devices)

    @return { Top: number, Bottom: number, Left: number, Right: number }
]]
function Device.GetSafeAreaInsets()
    local insets = Services.GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    return {
        Top = insets.Y,
        Bottom = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaBottom or 0,
        Left = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaLeft or 0,
        Right = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaRight or 0,
    }
end

--[[
    Gets the current viewport size

    @return Vector2 - Viewport dimensions
]]
function Device.GetViewportSize()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return DEFAULT_VIEWPORT
    end

    return camera.ViewportSize
end

return Device
end

__modules["Utils.Draggable"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Draggable Utility

    Makes UI elements draggable with mouse and touch support.
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")

local Draggable = {}


--[[
    Makes a frame draggable

    @param frame GuiObject - The frame to make draggable
    @param handle GuiObject? - Optional handle element (defaults to frame)
    @return DraggableConnection - Connection object to disconnect

    @example
    local connection = Draggable.Enable(window, titleBar)
    -- Later: connection.Disconnect()
]]
function Draggable.Enable(frame, handle)
    handle = handle or frame

    local dragging = false
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPos

    local connections= {}

    local function onInputBegan(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position

            local dragInputRef = input
            local inputConnection
            inputConnection = Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endInput)
                if endInput == dragInputRef then
                    dragging = false
                    inputConnection:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            table.insert(connections, inputConnection)
        end
    end

    local function onInputChanged(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections, handle.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan))
    table.insert(connections, handle.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged))

    table.insert(
        connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    )

    return {
        Disconnect = function()
            for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
            table.clear(connections)
        end,
    }
end

return Draggable
end

__modules["Utils.IconResolver"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Icon Resolver

    Resolves icon strings into Image descriptors.

    Supported formats:
        "rbxassetid://12345"      -> pass-through asset
        "solar/home-bold"         -> fetches from a pack URL on first use
        nil / "" / unknown        -> Resolve returns nil

    Pack resolution is wrapped in pcall and only triggered when the
    input is a "pack/name" string whose pack is listed in PackURLs.
    In Studio or any environment without HttpGet/loadstring, the
    resolver returns nil and the caller is expected to fall back.
]]

local IconResolver = {}

IconResolver.PackURLs = {
    solar = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/solar/dist/Icons.lua",
    lucide = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/lucide/dist/Icons.lua",
    gravity = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/gravity/dist/Icons.lua",
}

local _cache= {}
local _warned= {}

local ASSET_PREFIX = "rbxassetid://"

local function getExecutorEnv()
    local genv = if type(_G) == "table" then rawget(_G, "getgenv") else nil
    if type(genv) == "function" then
        local ok, env = pcall(genv)
        if ok and type(env) == "table" then
            return env
        end
    end

    if type(_G) == "table" then
        return _G
    end

    return nil
end

local function fetchUrl(url)
    local httpGet = game["HttpGet"]
    if type(httpGet) == "function" then
        local ok, body = pcall(httpGet, game, url, true)
        if ok and type(body) == "string" then
            return body
        end
    end

    local env = getExecutorEnv()
    if env then
        local request = env.request or env.http_request
        if type(request) ~= "function" and type(env.syn) == "table" then
            request = env.syn.request
        end
        if type(request) ~= "function" and type(env.http) == "table" then
            request = env.http.request
        end

        if type(request) == "function" then
            local ok, response = pcall(request, {
                Url = url,
                Method = "GET",
            })
            if ok then
                if type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string" then
                    return response.Body
                end
                if type(response) == "string" then
                    return response
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local ok, body = pcall(function()
        return httpService:GetAsync(url, true)
    end)
    if ok and type(body) == "string" then
        return body
    end

    return nil
end

function IconResolver.IsAsset(icon)
    if icon == nil or type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return false
    end
    return string.sub(icon, 1, 12) == ASSET_PREFIX
end

function IconResolver.ParsePackPath(icon)
    if icon == nil or type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    if IconResolver.IsAsset(icon) then
        return nil
    end
    local slash = string.find(icon, "/", 1, true)
    if not slash then
        return nil
    end
    local pack = string.sub(icon, 1, slash - 1)
    local name = string.sub(icon, slash + 1)
    if pack == "" or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return pack, name
end

local function _loadPack(pack)
    local url = IconResolver.PackURLs[pack]
    if not url then
        return nil
    end
    local body = fetchUrl(url)
    if type(body) ~= "string" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(string.format("[AcrylicUI] Failed to fetch icon pack '%s'", pack))
        end
        return nil
    end
    local chunk, loadErr = loadstring(body)
    if type(chunk) ~= "function" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(
                string.format(
                    "[AcrylicUI] Failed to load icon pack '%s': %s",
                    pack,
                    tostring(loadErr)
                )
            )
        end
        return nil
    end
    local dataOk, data = pcall(chunk)
    if not dataOk or type(data) ~= "table" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(string.format("[AcrylicUI] Icon pack '%s' did not return a table", pack))
        end
        return nil
    end
    return data
end

local function _lookup(packData, name)
    if type(packData) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    local direct = packData[name]
    if direct ~= nil then
        return direct
    end
    local sprites = packData.Spritesheets
    if type(sprites) == "table" then
        local entry = sprites[name]
        if entry ~= nil then
            return entry
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function IconResolver.Resolve(icon)
    if icon == nil or type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    if IconResolver.IsAsset(icon) then
        return { Image = icon }
    end
    local pack, name = IconResolver.ParsePackPath(icon)
    if not pack then
        return nil
    end
    if not IconResolver.PackURLs[pack] then
        return nil
    end
    if _cache[pack] == false then
        return nil
    end
    local packData = _cache[pack]
    if packData == nil then
        packData = _loadPack(pack)
        if packData == nil then
            _cache[pack] = false
            return nil
        end
        _cache[pack] = packData
    end
    local entry = _lookup(packData, name)
    if entry == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(entry) == "string" then
        return { Image = entry }
    end
    if type(entry) == "table" and entry.Image ~= nil then
        return entry
    end
    return nil
end

return IconResolver
end

__modules["Utils.Services"] = function()
--[[
    Acrylic UI Library
    Services Module - Centralized service management

    @author Acrylic Team
    @version 2.0.0
    @license MIT
]]

local Services = {
    TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"),
    UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService"),
    Players = game:GetService("Players"),
    Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"),
    RunService = game:GetService("RunService"),
    GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService"),
    HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService"),
}

return Services
end

__modules["Utils.Tween"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Tween Utilities

    Animation helper functions using TweenService.
]]

local Services = __require("Utils.Services")
local Animation = __require("Constants.Animation")

local Tween = {}

-- Active tweens cache for cleanup
local ActiveTweens= {}

--[[
    Creates and plays a tween animation

    @param instance Instance - The instance to animate
    @param properties table - Properties to animate
    @param duration number | string? - Duration or preset name
    @param easingStyle Enum.EasingStyle? - Easing style
    @param easingDirection Enum.EasingDirection? - Easing direction
    @return Tween - The created tween

    @example
    Tween.Create(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }, "Fast")
]]
function Tween.Create(
    instance,
    properties,
    duration,
    easingStyle,
    easingDirection
)
    -- Cancel existing tween on same instance
    if ActiveTweens[instance] then
        ActiveTweens[instance]:Cancel()
    end

    local tweenInfo = Animation.CreateTweenInfo(
        duration or Animation.Duration.Normal,
        easingStyle,
        easingDirection
    )

    local tween = Services.TweenService:Create(instance, tweenInfo, properties)
    ActiveTweens[instance] = tween

    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        if ActiveTweens[instance] == tween then
            ActiveTweens[instance] = nil
        end
    end)

    tween:Play()
    return tween
end

--[[
    Creates a tween with callback on completion

    @param instance Instance - The instance to animate
    @param properties table - Properties to animate
    @param duration number | string? - Duration or preset name
    @param callback function - Function to call on completion
    @return Tween
]]
function Tween.CreateWithCallback(
    instance,
    properties,
    duration,
    callback
)
    local tween = Tween.Create(instance, properties, duration)
    tween.Completed:Connect(callback)
    return tween
end

--[[
    Cancels all active tweens
]]
function Tween.CancelAll()
    for _, tween in pairs(ActiveTweens) do
        tween:Cancel()
    end
    table.clear(ActiveTweens)
end

--[[
    Cancels tween for specific instance

    @param instance Instance - The instance to cancel tween for
]]
function Tween.Cancel(instance)
    if ActiveTweens[instance] then
        ActiveTweens[instance]:Cancel()
        ActiveTweens[instance] = nil
    end
end

return Tween
end

return __require("init")
